items.title: Privacy Foundations for Multi-Institutional Scientific Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Scientific artificial intelligence (AI), spanning foundation models (FMs) to federated data-analysis pipelines, is becoming shared infrastructure across national laboratories, universities, hospitals, and industrial partners. This collaboration creates privacy risks whose natural unit is often an institution's participation, research strategy, or technical capability rather than a single record. Differential privacy (DP), federated learning (FL), secure computation, trusted execution, and provenance each protect parts of the stack, but their guarantees rarely compose across mixed-trust institutions, access tiers, and autonomous agents. This perspective recasts privacy for scientific AI as an assurance problem defined by six elements: protected asset, observer, channel, permitted disclosure, guarantee, and evidence. We demonstrate the framing through a claim register for a composite cross-institutional scenario and use it to assess the model lifecycle. Two of the resulting gaps are specific to leadership-class facilities: scheduler, allocation, and telemetry metadata expose an institution's resource posture, and instrument-attached control loops leak research strategy through timing and contention on shared accelerators. We identify six research priorities: institution-level guarantees, agent-communication privacy, cross-tier information flow, privacy-compatible reproducibility, leadership-scale accounting, and instrument side channels. The contribution is a common form for stating, comparing, and auditing claims whose guarantees otherwise remain fragmented across the scientific AI stack.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文是一篇立场/框架型（perspective）研究，聚焦多机构协作场景下科学人工智能的隐私问题。背景是：科学 AI——从基础模型（FM）到联邦数据分析流水线——正成为国家实验室、大学、医院与工业伙伴之间的共享基础设施。这种协作带来的隐私风险，其自然计量单元往往不是单条数据记录，而是「某机构的参与事实、研究策略或技术能力」。现有技术栈中，差分隐私（DP）、联邦学习（FL）、安全计算、可信执行环境与数据溯源各自保护其中一部分，但在混合信任的机构、不同访问层级与自治代理之间，这些保证很难组合（compose），导致整体安全声明碎片化、难以比较与审计。

论文的核心方法是将科学 AI 隐私重新表述为一个「保证（assurance）问题」，并用六个要素来定义任一隐私声明：受保护资产、观察者、信道、允许的披露、保证强度、证据。作者通过构建一个跨机构复合场景的「声明登记册（claim register）」来演示该框架，并用它沿模型生命周期逐阶段评估隐私保证的覆盖与缺口。

分析识别出两个专属于领导级（leadership-class）超算设施的缺口：其一，调度器、资源分配与遥测元数据会暴露某机构的资源态势（例如算力储备与研究投入）；其二，与仪器耦合的控制回路会通过共享加速器上的时序与资源争用，间接泄露研究策略。基于此，论文提出六个研究优先方向：机构级保证、代理通信隐私、跨信任层级的信息流控制、隐私兼容的可复现性、领导级规模下的隐私核算、以及仪器侧信道。

主要贡献并非新算法或新攻击，而是提供一种统一的形式化表达，使原本分散在科学 AI 技术栈各层的隐私声明可以被一致地陈述、比较和审计。适合隐私工程、联邦学习、科研计算平台治理与合规审计方向的研究者与安全架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它指出多机构 AI 协作的隐私边界已从「单条记录」上移到机构参与度、研究策略与元数据，并点名调度/遥测元数据与加速器时序侧信道这两类超算特有泄露面，可直接用于隐私威胁建模与合规审计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于国家实验室、高校、医院与工业伙伴联合训练或联邦分析场景；可迁移至医疗联邦学习、跨机构模型共享、可信执行与调度遥测治理，以及多智能体科研流水线的隐私影响评估。
detection_signals_zh: 对调度器、资源分配与集群遥测元数据的异常批量读取、导出或跨机构共享
共享加速器上异常的时序抖动、资源争用模式与任务共置关系变化
代理/流水线组件间的通信元数据（频次、体量、时序）出现与研究阶段不匹配的模式
同一机构在跨机构协作中的参与度、配额或能力指标被非授权方推断或聚合
隐私声明与实际数据流、访问层级不一致（缺少证据支撑的保证声明）
defense_advice_zh: 为跨机构科学 AI 项目建立「隐私声明登记册」，逐条记录受保护资产、观察者、信道、允许披露、保证与证据，并定期复核
对调度、分配与遥测元数据实施分级访问与最小披露，必要时做聚合、加噪或延迟发布
对共享加速器上的控制回路与作业共置做时序侧信道评估，避免研究策略可被推断
明确 DP、FL、安全计算、可信执行与溯源各组件的组合语义，避免假设保证可自动叠加
将代理间通信纳入隐私影响评估（PIA），对通信元数据同样做最小化处理
把「隐私兼容的可复现性」纳入实验与发布流程，防止复现材料反向泄露敏感信息
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：纳入内部多机构 AI 协作的隐私威胁建模与合规评估参考，并据此梳理自身调度/遥测元数据与加速器共置的暴露面

items.title: Security Properties of Neural Networks as Decision Problems
items.summary: Certifying a deployed neural network raises decision problems that the verification literature has not classified: whether the model carries a backdoor planted in its training data, whether a fault in its stored parameters can drive it into an unsafe state, whether its output leaks a private part of its input. We formalise eight such problems and classify what we can. The organising observation is a logical one. The function computed by a piecewise linear network, together with all its node values, is definable by a quantifier-free formula of real addition of size linear in the network, so a property of the network is a quantifier-alternation sentence, which Sontag's 1985 theorem places in the polynomial hierarchy at the level of its prefix. Membership results are thus corollaries, and the argument makes plain what they need: that the quantified objects are inputs rather than the network's own parameters. Non-interference, monotonicity and counterfactual fairness have exactly the complexity of network equivalence and of interval verification, all co-NP- complete over ReLU. Detection of backdoor triggers from a quantised alphabet is Sigma_2^P-complete, one level above robustness certification, so it does not reduce to polynomially many robustness queries unless the hierarchy collapses. Inversion resistance is co-NP-complete for every l_p metric, p a fixed positive integer. Quantifying over parameters instead of inputs - the fault model of bit-flip attacks, radiation upsets and analog accelerators - makes verification exists-R-complete already for networks of identity nodes, for which every previously studied problem is in P, and it stays so when each parameter is confined to a box of inverse-polynomial width; the corresponding safety question is forall-R-complete for ReLU.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文研究神经网络作为决策问题的安全属性复杂度分类。作者指出，验证部署神经网络时会遇到验证文献未分类的决策问题：模型是否带有训练数据植入的后门、存储参数故障（比特翻转、辐射、模拟加速器）是否导致不安全状态、输出是否泄露输入隐私。作者形式化八类此类问题并给出可分类结果。核心观察是逻辑性的：分段线性网络计算的函数及其所有节点值，可由规模与网络线性的实加法无量词公式定义，因此网络属性是量词交替语句，Sontag 1985 定理将其置于多项式层级中前缀对应层级。成员性结果是推论，论证表明量化对象必须是输入而非网络参数。非干扰性、单调性和反事实公平性与网络等价和区间验证具有完全相同复杂度，在 ReLU 上均为 co-NP 完全。从量化字母表检测后门触发器是 Sigma_2^P 完全，比鲁棒性认证高一层，因此除非层级坍缩，否则不能归约为多项式次鲁棒性查询。反演抵抗对每个 l_p 度量（p 固定正整数）是 co-NP 完全。量化参数而非输入（比特翻转攻击、辐射翻转、模拟加速器的故障模型）使得验证对恒等节点网络已是 exists-R 完全，而此前所有研究问题对这类网络都在 P 内；当每个参数限制在逆多项式宽度盒子内时仍成立；对应的 ReLU 安全性问题是 forall-R 完全。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作从计算复杂度角度划定神经网络安全验证的可行边界，揭示后门检测比鲁棒性认证更难、参数故障验证更难，为蓝队评估验证工具能力、选择检测策略提供理论依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响神经网络验证工具的设计与选用，尤其涉及后门检测、隐私泄露检测、参数故障容错等场景的复杂度预期；可迁移到模型供应链安全评估。
defense_advice_zh: 关注复杂度分类结果，避免对后门检测等难题承诺多项式时间验证
在参数故障场景中优先考虑运行时监控而非静态验证

items.title: Anchoring Adversarial Trajectories to Data Manifolds: A Bilevel Transfer Optimization Framework
items.summary: A key bottleneck in adversarial transfer is a trajectory-level geometric disconnect: ambient gradients often drift away from the intrinsic data manifold, causing surrogate-specific overfitting. To rectify this, we propose Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer (MABT), a unified framework that anchors adversarial trajectories to the shared semantic subspace. MABT introduces a relaxed manifold-anchoring operator as a semantic rectifier to suppress off-manifold noise. With this constraint, we cast transfer attack generation as a distributional bilevel optimization problem that learns a geometry-aligned initialization by minimizing expected transfer risk under a surrogate uncertainty distribution. We further develop a Hessian-free solver with linear-time complexity to handle the resulting hierarchy. Experiments demonstrate improved transferability for 10 baseline attackers across 28 attack configurations, diverse victim architectures, and defense mechanisms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注对抗样本的迁移性（transferability）问题，即在黑盒场景下，用替代（surrogate）模型生成的对抗扰动能否有效误导未见过的受害模型。作者指出，现有迁移攻击存在一个关键瓶颈：轨迹级的几何失配。基于环境空间（ambient space）计算得到的梯度往往会偏离数据本身所处的内在低维流形，使得优化过程被替代模型的特有特征带偏，产生替代模型过拟合，从而降低跨模型迁移成功率。为缓解这一问题，论文提出统一框架 MABT（Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer，流形锚定双层迁移）。其核心思路是把对抗轨迹锚定到多个模型共享的语义子空间上：首先引入一个松弛的流形锚定算子（relaxed manifold-anchoring operator），充当语义整流器，用于抑制偏离流形的噪声分量，使扰动在语义上更稳定、更可能被不同架构共同感知。在该约束下，作者把迁移攻击的生成过程形式化为一个分布级双层优化（distributional bilevel optimization）问题：内层求解给定初始化下的扰动，外层则在替代模型的不确定性分布下最小化期望迁移风险，从而学习到一个几何对齐的初始化点，而不是依赖单一替代模型的局部最优。为求解这种嵌套结构带来的计算开销，论文进一步设计了一种无需计算 Hessian 的求解器，复杂度为线性时间，使其在大规模模型上仍具可行性。实验方面，作者在 10 个基线攻击方法、28 种攻击配置上验证了该框架的通用性，并覆盖多种受害模型架构与多类防御机制，结果显示迁移性获得一致提升，表明流形几何约束与双层初始化学习可以与现有攻击方法解耦组合。整体而言，这是一篇偏向对抗机器学习与优化理论的论文，适合从事鲁棒性评估、红队测试、模型安全评测以及对抗训练的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 迁移性提升意味着仅靠隐藏模型权重、模型集成或简单输入预处理，难以充分抵御黑盒对抗评估；防御方在做鲁棒性测评与红队评估时，需把流形几何与跨架构泛化纳入考量。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响视觉/深度学习模型的鲁棒性评估流程：可用于检验现有防御（对抗训练、输入净化、集成与随机化）在跨架构黑盒条件下的真实有效性，也可迁移到多模态与其它基于梯度的模型评测场景。
detection_signals_zh: 入模输入呈现出与自然样本语义子空间偏离较小但在像素/特征空间存在高幅扰动的异常模式
同一批样本在多个不同架构模型上出现高度一致的错误分类聚集
推理请求中特征嵌入的流形距离分布相对基线的系统性偏移（需自行建立基线）
defense_advice_zh: 在鲁棒性测评基线中引入跨架构、多配置的黑盒迁移评估，而非仅用同架构白盒指标
对对抗训练与输入净化类防御，补充在语义流形约束类扰动下的再评估
关注并复现该类双层/流形约束方法作为评测工具，用于度量自身防御的泛化边界
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，纳入内部模型鲁棒性评估方法论参考

items.title: System-Level Optimization Beyond Cryptographic Kernels: An ML-KEM Case Study on Arm Cortex-M7
items.summary: Recent work on embedded post-quantum cryptography has focused primarily on instruction-level optimization, including arithmetic-kernel improvements, assembly tuning, register allocation, and instruction scheduling. Using the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) on an Arm Cortex-M7 as a case study, we examine the additional gains available from memory-hierarchy utilization, tightly coupled memory placement, peripheral integration, clock configuration, and deterministic public-data reuse. The evaluation starts from a state-of-the-art SLOTHY-optimized implementation and covers all three ML-KEM parameter sets. Without modifying the cryptographic algorithm or standardized wire formats, the evaluated profiles without auxiliary public state reduce cycles by up to 2.5%. A selected public-data-reuse profile reduces encapsulation and decapsulation cycles by up to 74.6% and 58.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that substantial deployment gains remain after arithmetic-kernel optimization and motivate a two-stage methodology that also examines the surrounding execution system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注嵌入式设备上后量子密码的部署效率。此前围绕 ML-KEM（Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism，即 NIST FIPS 203 标准化算法）在 Arm Cortex-M7 上的工作，几乎都聚焦于指令级优化，例如算术内核改进、手写汇编调优、寄存器分配与指令调度（如 SLOTHY 超优化框架）。本文提出一个不同视角：在算术内核之外，围绕执行系统的『系统级』因素同样存在可观的性能空间。作者以 Cortex-M7 为案例，系统评估了内存层次利用、紧耦合内存（TCM）放置、外设集成、时钟配置以及确定性公开数据复用等多个维度的调优手段。实验以当前最先进的 SLOTHY 优化实现作为基线，覆盖 ML-KEM 全部三个参数集（512/768/1024）。结果表明，在不修改密码算法本身、也不改变标准化线格式的前提下，不含辅助公开状态的优化剖面可将周期数最多降低约 2.5%；而选定的公开数据复用剖面，封装（encapsulation）与解封装（decapsulation）周期数最多分别降低 74.6% 和 58.8%。作者据此指出，算术内核优化之后仍存在大量部署侧收益，并提出一种『两阶段』优化方法学：除内核优化外，还需审视周边执行系统。论文属于性能工程与实现优化研究，而非算法安全性分析，其结论对嵌入式 PQC 固件的资源预算与集成方式具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: PQC 正进入嵌入式与物联网落地阶段，ML-KEM 在 Cortex-M7 这类 MCU 上的实时性与资源占用直接影响升级排期。该研究提示安全团队：仅看算术内核基准会低估实际开销，系统级内存布局与公开数据复用可带来数量级差异；同时需审计公开数据复用是否引入与密钥相关的时序侧信道。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围集中在嵌入式后量子密码固件：MCU 安全启动与安全通信栈、TLS/DTLS 终端协议栈、智能表计、工业控制器、车载 ECU、TEE/安全元件周边集成等场景。该两阶段方法论可迁移到其他 PQC 算法（如 ML-DSA、SLH-DSA）及其他 Cortex-M / RISC-V 平台的实现评估与性能验收。
detection_signals_zh: 固件链接脚本或内存映射中 TCM/SRAM 段划分与放置策略发生变更
构建配置中时钟树、外设时钟使能或等待周期参数被调整
PQC 相关固件的性能基准（周期计数、功耗曲线）出现异常跃升或跃降
实现代码中出现对公开多项式/公开数据的缓存或预计算复用路径
defense_advice_zh: 对采用公开数据复用的实现开展常量时间与缓存/时序侧信道复核，确认复用路径仅涉及公开数据且不产生与私钥相关的分支或访存模式
在变更 TCM 放置与时钟配置后重新回归侧信道测试向量，避免性能优化破坏既有防护
采用论文提出的两阶段方法学重建 PQC 固件的性能与安全预算模型，将系统级开销纳入验收指标
在采购或评估第三方 PQC 库时，要求提供基线版本与优化版本的完整性能与侧信道测试报告
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler
items.summary: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 差分隐私(DP)的正式隐私保证依赖噪声分布的精确采样: 若采样器实现存在偏差, 所声称的 ε/δ 保证就会失真。本文报告在 OpenDP 的离散拉普拉斯(discrete Laplace)采样器中发现系统性伪影——输出分布呈现周期性畸变, 表明采样结果并未严格服从目标分布。作者通过系统化测试, 将缺陷溯源到 bernoulli_exp1 这一底层原语: 它负责从 Bernoulli(e^{-x}) 分布采样, 而其内部依赖的有理数(rational arithmetic)库实现有误, 该错误在嵌套采样层级中被逐级放大, 最终形成可观测的周期性模式。论文提出一套可复用的诊断方法, 在多层嵌套的采样结构中逐层隔离与比对, 从而精确定位故障组件, 而不是停留在端到端的经验性怀疑。在此基础上, 作者给出基于精确有理数算术的替代实现, 消除了周期性伪影。使用 10^6 个样本进行的统计验证表明, 修正后的采样器输出在测试精度下与理论分布不可区分。论文的主要贡献可归纳为三点: (1) 揭示 DP 库中容易被忽视的数值实现层风险, 提醒隐私保证不仅取决于数学定义, 也取决于底层算术原语; (2) 提供一套从现象(分布畸变)到根因(具体原语)的采样器缺陷诊断流程; (3) 给出修复方案并做大规模实证验证。适合 DP 实现者、隐私工程团队、统计计算库维护者以及安全审计人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: DP 的隐私承诺建立在采样正确性之上, 周期性伪影意味着实际隐私参数可能偏离声明值, 形成'接口合规但保证不可信'的隐患。其诊断思路可迁移到其他隐私/密码学采样实现的审计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用 OpenDP 及同类 DP 库构建的统计发布、联邦分析、合成数据与隐私保护查询系统; 同样适用于依赖有理数算术与拒绝采样/Bernoulli 原语的密码学与数值库。
detection_signals_zh: 对 DP 采样器输出做周期性、自相关检测与卡方拟合优度检验, 观察是否存在周期性畸变
同一机制在不同版本、平台或不同有理数算术后端下输出分布的一致性比对出现差异
端到端功能测试通过, 但对 bernoulli_exp1 等底层原语做分布级单元测试时暴露偏差
隐私预算审计中发现实测 ε 与声明值之间存在无法解释的偏移
defense_advice_zh: 升级或修补 OpenDP 及其有理数算术依赖, 并锁定经过统计验证的版本
将采样器分布正确性测试(拟合优度、周期性、大样本 KS/卡方)纳入 CI, 而非仅做接口级测试
对关键 DP 机制使用独立参考实现或高精度算术进行跨实现对照验证
跟踪依赖链中底层数值库的变更, 评估其对隐私参数与发布结果的影响
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进; 若内部使用 OpenDP 或同类 DP 组件, 建议纳入内部采样器统计验证评估

items.title: Robust and leakage-resilient device-independent oblivious transfer in MiniQCryp
items.summary: Assuming post-quantum one-way functions, we construct device-independent (DI) oblivious transfer (OT) and bit commitment: honest parties use only trusted classical computation to operate untrusted quantum devices, which may share arbitrary entanglement and behave non-IID. Security is simulation-based against quantum polynomial-time adversaries and composes sequentially with efficient simulators. One protocol skeleton serves both, in two regimes. With isolated laboratories and coordinate-local measurements in the honest receiver's device, it tolerates a constant rate of honest-device faults. With polylogarithmically many qubits of adaptive leakage between the laboratories and arbitrary joint measurements, it tolerates an inverse-polylogarithmic rate. Each elementary DI call uses a fresh, isolated batch of polylogarithmically many device coordinates, and total device use in the compiled OT protocol is polynomial. The commitment has efficient simulators against both parties and yields DI coin tossing with abort. Because OT is complete for secure computation, the construction yields a DI protocol, with abort, for every efficiently computable classical functionality on a fixed number of parties, secure against static corruption of any proper subset of them. The commitment's extractor changes a public parity relation through classical equivocation and leaves the device execution, hence its leakage, unchanged. A commit-and-prove functionality, disjoint audits, and an affine consistency check link the certified correlations to ideal OT. Sender security rests on a selector-aware parallel-repetition bound for the Magic Square game, which we derive from the two-round threshold theorem of Kundu and Tan.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究如何在不可信量子设备上实现设备无关（DI）的安全两方原语。设备无关密码学的核心思路是：参与者不信任量子设备的内部行为，仅依据观测到的输入输出相关性来保证安全。作者在 MiniQCrypt 模型（诚实方实验室相互隔离、只能运行可信经典计算、设备间可共享任意纠缠并表现出非 IID 行为）下，假设存在后量子单向函数，构造了 DI 不经意传输（OT）与 DI 比特承诺。两者共用同一套协议骨架，分两种工作情形：其一是实验室隔离、诚实接收方设备只做坐标局域测量的情形，可容忍诚实设备以常数比率出错；其二是实验室之间存在 polylog 量级的自适应泄漏且允许任意联合测量的情形，可容忍反 polylog 比率的错误。每次基本 DI 调用都使用一批崭新的、相互隔离的 polylog 个设备坐标，编译后的 OT 协议对设备的总调用量为多项式级。安全性采用模拟式定义，可抵御量子多项式时间敌手，并支持带高效模拟器的顺序组合。比特承诺的提取器通过经典含糊化（equivocation）修改一个公开的奇偶关系，而不改变设备执行过程，因此也不改变其泄漏。协议借助承诺-证明功能、互不相交的审计以及仿射一致性检查，把被认证的设备相关性连接到理想 OT。发送方安全性依赖于作者从 Kundu 与 Tan 的两轮阈值定理导出的、针对 Magic Square 博弈的选择器感知并行重复界。由于 OT 对安全计算是完备的，该构造对任意固定参与方数量上、任意高效可计算的经典功能都给出带中止的 DI 协议，并可抵御任意真子集的静态腐化；比特承诺还可推出带中止的 DI 抛硬币。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把设备无关安全从单一原语推进到通用安全计算，并在 MiniQCrypt 下同时处理设备故障与实验室间自适应泄漏，对后量子时代依赖不可信硬件的密码协议设计与信任模型有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于不可信量子硬件上的委托计算、多方安全计算以及需要弱化设备信任假设的密码协议场景；当前结论属理论可行性，短期不具备可直接利用的攻击面或部署价值。
defense_advice_zh: 跟踪量子/后量子密码方案中设备信任假设的演进，评估现有硬件信任模型是否仍然成立
对计划采用设备无关或半设备无关方案的项目，把泄漏容忍度与设备故障率纳入安全需求基线
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: GNSS Spoofing in Mobile Devices: A Survey on Impact and Countermeasures
items.summary: Smartphones rely on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning for many of the functions they execute everyday. The GNSS receivers embedded in smartphones are susceptible to anthropogenic radio frequency interference attacks in the forms of jamming and spoofing due to the low-power and open-architecture signals they receive from the satellite constellations. While jamming is a practice that denies a GNSS receiver the ability to form a position, velocity, and time (PVT) solution, spoofing represents a more insidious threat by using forged satellite signals that aim at causing the victim receiver to compute a false PVT solution. The ubiquity of smartphones and the sensitive geolocation data they hold make them a primary target for malicious spoofing. However, their hardware constraints and the lack of deep visibility into the GNSS receiver processing chain create significant hurdles for effective countermeasures. Existing surveys comprehensively explore general spoofing countermeasures but fail to address these mobile-specific limitations. This article fills that gap with a novel survey focused on techniques viable within the unique constraints of smartphone architectures. Specifically, we establish a taxonomy for defining GNSS spoofing attack effects and countermeasures, provide a historical review of smartphone vulnerability characterization, and provide an overview of techniques proposed to detect and counteract smartphone spoofing threats, offering a comparative framework to weigh their respective pros and cons on mobile platforms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这是一篇聚焦智能手机 GNSS 欺骗威胁与对策的综述性论文。背景上，现代智能手机的定位、导航、授时、地图、打车、移动支付风控、社交打卡、应急呼叫等功能高度依赖全球导航卫星系统（GNSS），而手机内置的 GNSS 接收机由于卫星信号到达地面功率极低、民用信号体制公开，天然易受人为射频干扰攻击。作者将攻击划分为两类：一是压制/干扰（jamming），直接剥夺接收机形成位置-速度-时间（PVT）解算的能力，属于可用性攻击；二是欺骗（spoofing），通过伪造卫星信号诱导受害接收机输出错误的 PVT 解，属于更隐蔽的完整性攻击，可被用于位置伪造、地理围栏绕过、基于位置的访问控制欺骗等场景。文章指出，智能手机的普及性及其承载的高敏感地理位置数据，使其成为恶意欺骗的首要目标。然而现有综述大多讨论通用 GNSS 欺骗对抗技术，忽视了移动端的特殊约束：手机通常只有单天线、低成本低功耗芯片组、无法访问原始观测量与接收机内部处理链、固件与基带闭源、算力与功耗预算受限、且需在动态城市环境中运行。这些限制使得许多学术界的先进对抗方案难以直接落地到手机平台。针对这一空白，本文贡献了一个面向移动端的新型综述：第一，建立了统一的分类体系，用于刻画 GNSS 欺骗的攻击效应（如定位偏移、定时偏移、轨迹篡改等）以及对应对策类别；第二，对智能手机脆弱性表征的历史研究进行了回顾，梳理了认知演进；第三，系统概述了在手机架构约束下可行的检测与对抗技术，并给出比较框架以评估各方案在移动平台上的优缺点。适合关注定位安全、移动平台安全、位置数据可信度与反欺诈的安全研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 位置数据是移动端风控、地理围栏、应急定位与合规审计的关键输入，一旦被欺骗，基于位置的信任决策会整体失效。本文提供了面向手机约束的威胁分类与对策比较框架，可作为移动定位安全评估与选型的参考基线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到移动反欺诈、网约车与外卖派单、共享出行围栏、儿童/老人定位、紧急呼叫定位、基于位置的身份核验等场景；也适用于评估车队与物联网终端因使用手机级 GNSS 芯片而继承的同类风险。
detection_signals_zh: 定位结果与蜂窝/Wi-Fi/惯导推算轨迹出现持续且方向一致的系统性偏移
PVT 解算跳变但速度、航向与加速度物理上不自洽（运动学一致性破坏）
接收机自动增益控制（AGC）或信噪比（C/N0）出现异常抬升或平坦化
多星座/多频点解算之间出现异常分歧，或时间同步出现异常偏移
应用层出现突发的围栏穿越、打卡位置异常或大量设备在相近坐标聚集
defense_advice_zh: 在应用层引入多源交叉校验：将 GNSS 与蜂窝、Wi-Fi、蓝牙、IMU、地图匹配结果做一致性打分
对位置相关敏感操作实施风险分级，异常定位下触发二次认证或人工审核
优先选择支持多星座、多频点并对外提供原始观测量或硬件级完整性指标的终端与芯片方案
建立位置轨迹的历史基线模型，对突变与长期静默后跳变进行告警
跟踪标准组织与厂商的 GNSS 认证/抗欺骗能力声明，将抗欺骗能力纳入终端采购与准入要求
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：通读全文的分类体系与对策比较框架，评估其中哪些检测思路可在我方移动端风控与终端准入中试点。

items.title: Harbormaster: Evidence-Gated, Replay-Safe Maritime Anomaly Detection on AWS
items.summary: Ships broadcast their positions through the Automatic Identification System (AIS), and those reports can be false or missing. An operator who acts on an anomaly alert needs that alert to be attributable, reviewable, and recoverable after a failure. This paper describes Harbormaster, a production-shaped system on AWS that follows three rules. Physics checks run on every report before any learned model runs. The DynamoDB read store is an idempotent projection of PostgreSQL, and a guard on the log sequence number (LSN) of each change protects every write to it. A candidate model must pass a holdout gate and a shadow comparison before a canary gives it traffic, and a burn-rate check guards each canary step. The paper proves that replaying any prefix or suffix of the change log leaves each projected key at the value of its highest applied LSN. It also notes effects this result does not cover, such as repeated cache invalidations and repeated audit rows. In a bounded AWS window, a one-hour soak returned 35,999 HTTP 200 responses to 36,000 requests, with a 95th-percentile (p95) client latency of 142.751 ms. In a separate bounded AWS run of 900 s, the stream path received a burst of 400 records/s, and its consumer lag later drained to zero. Every number in the paper carries a label that says where it was measured, and the paper lists the parts of the design that were never built.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并实现了一个名为 Harbormaster 的、具备“生产形态”的海事异常检测系统，部署在 AWS 上，用于处理船舶自动识别系统（AIS）广播的位置报文。研究背景是：AIS 报文既可能是伪造的，也可能缺失，而值班操作员在收到异常告警后，必须能够追溯该告警的来源、复核其判断依据，并在系统发生故障后恢复到一致状态——也就是说，告警系统本身需要具备可归因、可审计、可恢复的能力，而不仅仅是追求检测准确率。为此，作者为系统设定并贯彻了三条设计规则。第一，任何来自学习模型的判断之前，必须先对每一条报文执行物理一致性检查，即用规则化的物理约束做前置过滤，避免模型直接消费明显不合理的数据。第二，面向查询的 DynamoDB 读存储被定义为 PostgreSQL 变更日志的幂等投影，每次写入都受该变更对应日志序列号（LSN）守卫的保护，从而保证写入不会被乱序或重复应用。第三，候选模型必须先通过留出集（holdout）门禁与影子流量对比，才能通过金丝雀发布获得真实流量，且每一档金丝雀推进都由燃烧率（burn-rate）检查把关。论文从理论上证明：对变更日志的任意前缀或后缀进行重放，每个被投影的键最终都会停留在其已应用过的最高 LSN 所对应的值上，即重放是安全的（replay-safe）。作者同时诚实地指出了该结论未覆盖的副作用，例如缓存失效与审计行可能被重复触发。实验方面，在一个有明确边界的 AWS 运行窗口内，一小时的浸泡测试对 36000 次请求返回了 35999 个 HTTP 200 响应，客户端延迟 p95 为 142.751 毫秒；在另一次 900 秒的受限 AWS 运行中，流式路径承受了每秒 400 条记录的突发，随后消费者延迟（consumer lag）被完全排空至零。论文中每一个数字都带有“在何处测得”的标签，并明确列出了设计中从未真正实现的部分。整体而言，这是一篇偏工程与系统可靠性取向的工作，核心贡献在于把“证据门禁 + 重放安全 + 渐进式模型发布”这三类机制组合成一个可复现的海事异常检测参考架构，适合读者为构建关键基础设施检测平台的系统工程师、MLOps 工程师与安全运营架构师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AIS 伪造与丢失是航运与港口安全中的现实威胁，而告警若不可追溯、不可重放，防御方就无法在事后取证或恢复。该文给出的物理前置校验、LSN 守卫的幂等投影、模型留出门禁与金丝雀燃烧率控制，可直接迁移到任何关键基础设施的异常检测流水线，降低误报与故障放大风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于航运/港口态势感知、关键基础设施流式检测、以及任何需要“告警可归因 + 失败可恢复”的 MLOps 平台。其重放安全证明与证据门禁思路可迁移到日志投影、事件溯源、模型渐进发布等场景；但论文明确列出未实现部分，落地前需自行补齐缓存与审计去重逻辑。
detection_signals_zh: AIS 报文与物理约束冲突（位置跳变、航速/航向不合理、时间戳异常）
同一船舶标识在短时间窗口内出现在地理上不可达的位置
变更日志重放导致同一键被反复写入或审计行重复
流式消费者延迟（consumer lag）持续累积未回落
金丝雀阶段燃烧率超阈值或影子模型与线上模型输出显著背离
DynamoDB 投影与 PostgreSQL 源数据出现版本/LSN 不一致
defense_advice_zh: 将确定性的物理/业务规则校验置于学习模型之前，作为第一道证据门禁，减少模型对脏数据的依赖
对读侧存储采用幂等投影设计，并以 LSN 等单调序列号守卫写入，确保重放与故障恢复后状态收敛
模型上线实行留出集门禁 + 影子对比 + 金丝雀 + 燃烧率检查的渐进式发布，任何一步异常自动回滚
为缓存失效与审计记录补充去重/幂等处理，弥补论文指出的重放安全未覆盖范围
对指标口径做显式标注（测量位置、时间窗、边界条件），避免跨环境误用性能数字

items.title: Query-Limited RAM Programs and their Applications
items.summary: Quantum one-time programs (Broadbent, Gutoski and Stebila, CRYPTO 2013) or OTPs for short, enable a functionality to be encoded into a quantum token that can be evaluated on a single chosen input and then becomes unusable. While powerful, this primitive is inherently stateless and tied to a setting in which a quantum token needs to be issued and distributed for every single evaluation of a circuit. This raises a natural question: can the one-time computation paradigm be extended to richer, stateful forms of controlled access, and would such an extension offer inherent advantages beyond standard OTPs? We introduce $\textit{query-limited RAM programs}$ (QLPs), a RAM-generalization of QOTPs that supports structured, stateful computation under bounded or policy-driven access. QLPs allow controlled sequences of evaluations while preventing adversarial forking or rollback of computational state. This enables new applications beyond stateless one-time programs, including quantum tokens for Turing Machines whose size depends only on $\textit{code length}$ (and not runtime), transferable $k$-time or budget-limited programs, and low-communication mechanisms for delegating computation in settings such as Software-as-a-Service. To construct QLPs, we introduce $\textit{one-shot programs}$, unifying one-shot signatures (Amos, Georgiou, Kiayias and Zhandry, STOC 2020) with the single effective query paradigm (Gupte, Liu, Raizes, Roberts and Vaikuntanathan, STOC 2025). We prove that one-shot programs generically imply query-limited programs, demonstrating that the strengthened unclonability guarantees of one-shot signatures translate into enhanced functionality. Along the way, we clarify the relationship between signature-token primitives and quantum one-time programs via generic constructions, essentially showing that one-time signing programs imply one-time general computation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究量子密码学中的量子一次性程序（Quantum One-Time Programs，OTP/QOTP）：它把一个电路功能编码进一个量子令牌，令牌仅能在单个指定输入上求值一次，随后即失效。OTP 虽然功能强大，但本质上是无状态的，必须为每一次电路求值单独签发并分发一个新的量子令牌，这在需要重复、受控访问的场景中代价高昂。论文提出的核心问题是：一次性计算范式能否推广到更丰富的、有状态的受控访问形式，且这种推广是否带来超越标准 OTP 的固有优势。为此，作者定义了“查询受限 RAM 程序”（Query-Limited RAM Programs，QLP），它是 QOTP 在随机存取机（RAM）模型上的推广，支持在有界或策略驱动的访问约束下执行结构化、有状态的计算；QLP 允许受控的多次求值序列，同时阻止攻击者分叉（forking）或回滚（rollback）计算状态。基于 QLP，论文给出若干新应用：其大小只依赖于“代码长度”而非运行时间的图灵机量子令牌；可转移的 k 次程序或预算受限程序；以及面向软件即服务（SaaS）等场景的低通信量计算委托机制。构造方面，作者引入“一次性程序”（one-shot programs）这一新原语，把一次性签名（Amos、Georgiou、Kiayias、Zhandry，STOC 2020）与单次有效查询范式（Gupte、Liu、Raizes、Roberts、Vaikuntanathan，STOC 2025）统一起来，并证明一次性程序可以通用地推出查询受限程序，说明一次性签名更强的不可克隆性保证能够转化为更强的功能。论文还通过通用构造厘清了签名类令牌原语与量子一次性程序之间的关系，实质上表明一次性签名程序可蕴含一次性通用计算。整体属于理论密码学/量子密码学成果，以构造与归约证明为主。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对关注后量子密码学与安全外包的从业者而言，它提供了把一次性程序从无状态扩展到有状态、策略驱动访问的理论框架，并厘清了一次性签名与量子一次性计算之间的构造性联系，有助于评估未来量子令牌类信任模型的边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到安全计算委托、SaaS 场景下的低通信外包、可转移的 k 次/预算受限许可证与配额管理、以及运行时间与代码长度解耦的图灵机级量子令牌等长期方向；当前为理论成果，暂无直接工程落地或攻击面。
defense_advice_zh: 将其纳入后量子密码学与安全外包方向的长期理论跟踪，评估既有无状态一次性令牌方案在未来状态化访问需求下的适用性边界。
在涉及多次、可转移计算委托的产品规划中，关注“防分叉、防回滚”这一安全属性，作为未来可信执行与配额控制机制的设计参考。

items.title: Verifiable quantum advantage based on polynomials with planted structures
items.summary: A central question in the theory of quantum advantage is whether there are quantum advantage protocols with similar resource requirements as random circuit sampling that are also verifiable just from the classical outputs of the quantum computation. Here, we develop the idea of simulation secrets for verifiable advantage. A verifier can use a simulation secret to evaluate a cross-entropy test faster than it would take a classical adversary to pass the test. We instantiate this idea using IQP circuits described by cubic polynomials with planted independent spaces. These correspond to the largest independent set in the orbit of a polynomial under the general linear group and yield a low-rank stabilizer decomposition of the corresponding state. We conjecture that large independent spaces are invisible to a computationally bounded adversary, and therefore they cannot exploit them to pass the protocol. A second conjecture regards the fine-grained complexity of producing samples that pass the cross-entropy test for uniformly random polynomials. Under these conjectures, our scheme results in a polynomial gap between the verification time and the time a classical adversary would need to pass the protocol---both are exponential. It has a potential application to generating classically certifiable randomness, since the output distributions have high min-entropy. We estimate that the planted polynomial scheme is implementable using 100 logical qubits at logical error rates around $10^{-6}$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究量子优势协议的可验证性问题：是否存在与随机电路采样（RCS）资源需求相近、但仅凭量子计算的经典输出即可被经典验证者验证的量子优势协议。作者提出"模拟秘密（simulation secret）"概念：验证者掌握该秘密后，可以比经典对手更快地完成交叉熵测试（cross-entropy test），从而在不额外依赖量子硬件或交互式挑战的前提下确认计算确实具有量子性。具体实现基于具有"植入独立空间（planted independent spaces）"的三次多项式所描述的 IQP 电路：该独立空间对应多项式在一般线性群作用下轨道中的最大独立集，并诱导对应量子态具有低秩稳定子（stabilizer）分解，使验证者能够高效模拟并设置测试。作者提出两个猜想：(1) 对计算有界对手而言，大独立空间不可见，因此其无法利用该结构通过协议；(2) 对均匀随机多项式，生成能通过交叉熵测试的样本存在细粒度复杂度下界。在这两个猜想成立的前提下，验证者的验证时间与经典对手通过协议所需时间之间存在多项式级差距（两者均为指数级）。该方案还可用于生成可被经典方式认证的随机性，因为输出分布具有高最小熵。作者估计植入多项式方案可在约 100 个逻辑量子比特、逻辑错误率约 1e-6 的条件下实现。适合量子计算理论、可验证量子计算、量子优势与复杂度理论、以及量子随机性与密码学方向的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为"可验证量子优势"提供新范式：把验证成本压到经典可承受范围，直接影响量子云服务可信度评估、可认证随机性来源，以及密码系统对随机性假设的依赖；但结论建立在未证明猜想之上，不宜据此做安全决策。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 潜在影响量子云计算服务的可信验证标准、经典可认证随机数生成、以及量子优势声明的评估方法；对后量子密码与安全随机源设计存在间接关联。当前为理论工作，尚无直接产品化或攻击面影响。
detection_signals_zh: 无直接可落地的检测特征：属于理论协议研究，不涉及恶意软件、网络流量或主机行为

items.title: Quantum Advantage for Two-Party Differential Privacy
items.summary: We introduce information-theoretically private quantum protocols for two-party Hamming distance when both parties must output the same estimate. Classically, for input length $n$, information-theoretic protocols require $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ error under pure differential privacy and $Ω(\sqrt{n}/\log n)$ error under strong approximate differential privacy, whereas computational security permits $O(1)$ error. In Klauck's honest, nonpreemptive, message-preserving model, we give an $O(n)$-communication quantum protocol with pure $\varepsilon$ quantum differential privacy (QDP) and expected error at most $\frac{2}{\sinh \varepsilon}+γ$, for every $γ>0$. For approximate $(\varepsilon, δ)$ QDP, an exact hockey-stick divergence calculation yields strictly smaller error, while preserving the $O(1)$-versus-$Ω(\sqrt{n}/\log n)$ separation for $δ=o(1/n)$. Thus, quantum communication achieves $O(1)$ information-theoretic error, matching the accuracy available classically only under computational assumptions. The main construction uses a guarded coherent round trip and an equal-Gram rigidity principle that prevents an honest player from retaining input-dependent complementary information. We separate this model from weaker prescribed-channel privacy, which already admits an exact classical realization, and from fully retention-robust security, against which measurement-and-abort attacks remain possible. Therefore, we identify preservation of non-orthogonal quantum messages as a resource for privacy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究两方差分隐私（DP）下汉明距离计算的通信与精度权衡，并提出量子协议实现信息论意义上的常数误差。问题设定为：两方各自持有长度为 n 的 0/1 输入，需要在双方输出同一致估计值的前提下，以差分隐私保护各自输入。经典结论是：在信息论安全（不依赖计算假设）下，纯差分隐私的误差下界为 Ω(√n)，强近似差分隐私为 Ω(√n/log n)；只有引入计算性假设（如密码学硬度）才能把误差降到 O(1)。作者在 Klauck 提出的诚实、非抢占、消息保持（honest, nonpreemptive, message-preserving）模型中构造量子协议：通信量为 O(n)，满足纯 ε 量子差分隐私（QDP），期望误差不超过 2/sinh ε + γ，对任意 γ>0 成立。对近似 (ε,δ)-QDP，作者通过精确的 hockey-stick 散度计算得到更紧的误差界，并在 δ=o(1/n) 时仍保持 O(1) 与 Ω(√n/log n) 的分离。这意味着在纯信息论假设下量子通信即可达到 O(1) 误差，复现了经典模型必须依赖计算假设才能获得的精度。核心构造是“受保护相干往返”（guarded coherent round trip）与“等 Gram 刚性原理”（equal-Gram rigidity），后者阻止诚实参与方保留与输入相关的互补量子信息。作者进一步将该模型与两类更弱或更强的安全定义区分：较弱的预设信道隐私（prescribed-channel privacy）在经典下即可精确实现；而完全抗保留（fully retention-robust）安全仍会被“测量后中止”（measurement-and-abort）攻击攻破。结论是：保持非正交量子消息本身是一种可被利用的隐私资源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作从理论上证明量子通信可在信息论安全下实现常数误差的两方差分隐私，动摇了“高精度隐私计算必须依赖计算假设”的传统认知，为量子时代的隐私协议设计与安全边界评估提供了新的理论基线，但目前不涉及现实可部署系统。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响方向包括两方隐私计算/安全聚合的理论下界、量子通信网络（QKD、量子中继）上的隐私协议设计，以及未来对现有“信息论安全 DP 不可能性结论”的重新评估；短期内对现有经典系统的直接风险为零。
defense_advice_zh: 关注量子通信层面的元数据与信道侧信道监测，若未来出现基于量子信道的高精度隐私计算部署，传统基于通信量的隐私泄露分析模型将不再适用。
在内部隐私威胁建模时，区分“信息论安全”与“计算安全”两类假设，避免把计算假设下的 O(1) 精度当作信息论结论直接引用。
对涉及非正交量子态保留、测量后中止等行为的实验平台，纳入量子侧信道与设备可信度评估清单。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Device-Independent Conference Keys from Parity-Extended Games
items.summary: Device-independent conference key agreement (DI-CKA) lets a group of parties establish a shared secret key from untrusted quantum devices, with security certified by non-locality. Existing DI-CKA protocols are each built around a single Bell inequality, typically a multiparty variant of the CHSH game. DI-QKD protocols, in contrast, have been built from a much richer landscape of non-local games, and it has remained unclear how to carry this landscape over to the conference setting. We introduce $\textit{Parity-$G$ games}$, which extend any two-player game $G$ to $N$ players, for every $N$, provided $G$ has an optimal strategy in which one player measures Pauli observables. The extension preserves the quantum and classical values of $G$, and the security of the resulting $N$-party protocol follows from an analysis of the two-player game alone. Our framework recovers the Parity-CHSH game of Ribeiro, Murta and Wehner (Phys. Rev. A, 2018) as a special case. Applied to the Mermin--Peres Magic Square Game, it yields a new $N$-player pseudo-telepathy game, the $\textit{Parity Magic Square Game}$, which ideal devices win in every round. We use it to construct the $\textit{first}$ DI-CKA protocol based on a pseudo-telepathy game. We prove the protocol secure against coherent attacks. It produces up to two key bits per round, and at low noise its key rate exceeds that of the DI-CKA protocol based on the Parity-CHSH game.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究设备无关会议密钥协商（DI-CKA）：多名参与方利用不可信的量子设备协商出共享密钥，其安全性由非局域性（non-locality）认证，而不依赖对设备内部实现可信的假设。此前的 DI-CKA 协议几乎都围绕单一贝尔不等式构造，通常是多方 CHSH 博弈的变体；相比之下，设备无关量子密钥分发（DI-QKD）已经建立在更丰富的非局域博弈版图之上，但如何把这套版图迁移到多方会议场景长期不明确。

作者提出 Parity-G 博弈框架：只要两人博弈 G 存在一种最优策略，且该策略中某一方测量的是 Pauli 可观测量，就可以把 G 扩展成任意 N 人参与的博弈。该扩展保持 G 的量子值与经典值不变，并且 N 方协议的安全性可以仅凭对两人博弈的分析推出，从而显著简化多人安全证明。该框架把 Ribeiro、Murta 与 Wehner（Phys. Rev. A, 2018）提出的 Parity-CHSH 博弈作为特例纳入其中。

将该框架应用于 Mermin-Peres 魔方博弈（Magic Square Game），作者构造出一种新的 N 人伪心灵感应（pseudo-telepathy）博弈，即 Parity Magic Square Game，理想设备在每一轮都能获胜。以此为基础，作者给出首个基于伪心灵感应博弈的 DI-CKA 协议，并证明该协议能够抵御相干攻击（coherent attacks）。协议每轮最多产出两个密钥比特，在低噪声条件下其密钥率超过基于 Parity-CHSH 的 DI-CKA 协议。整体上这是量子密码理论与非局域博弈交叉方向的一项构造性成果，属于理论研究阶段，尚未涉及工程实现或部署评估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: DI-CKA/DI-QKD 是密码学的长期演进方向，而非即时威胁。该工作首次把伪心灵感应博弈引入多方密钥协商，扩展了可用的非局域博弈工具箱；安全团队应将其作为前瞻性研究跟踪，而非当下应急项。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 目前无现实攻击面或漏洞影响。潜在影响集中在未来密钥分发与多方安全通信的信任模型设计：若 DI-CKA 逐步成熟，可能削弱对可信硬件假设的依赖，并影响量子密钥分发标准化路线与密码敏捷性规划。
defense_advice_zh: 将其归入量子密码前瞻研究清单，定期跟踪 DI-CKA/DI-QKD 方向进展与标准化动向，不纳入近期威胁建模。
在密码敏捷性（crypto-agility）规划中记录该类协议演进，避免在工程选型时把理论阶段方案当作可部署能力。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Rate 1/5 Non-Malleable Codes against Entangled Split-State Tampering
items.summary: We construct efficient information-theoretic non-malleable codes for classical messages that are secure against two noncommunicating local quantum tampering operations with arbitrary pre-shared entanglement. For every sufficiently small fixed $ξ>0$ and all sufficiently large first-share lengths $n$, the codes have rate at least $1/5-ξ$, perfect correctness, and error $2^{-n^{Ω(1)}}$. Security holds for every message, with a single message-independent simulator for each attack. This resolves the constant-rate question for worst-case classical messages in the entangled two-split-state model. Our construction builds on the permutation-based two-split construction of Batra, Boddu, and Jain, which achieves rate approaching $1/5$ for uniformly random messages. We retain their architecture but replace the uniform message input to the permutation with a prescribed message concatenated with fresh uniform padding. Our main contribution is a worst-case security reduction for this modification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究非可塑编码（Non-Malleable Codes, NMC）在量子篡改模型下的构造与速率问题。非可塑编码的核心目标是：对消息编码后，若敌手对码字进行篡改，则解码结果要么与原消息完全一致，要么与消息完全无关（被彻底破坏），从而为防篡改存储与密码协议提供信息论层面的保证。经典的分裂状态（split-state）模型中，码字被拆成两份，敌手对两份分别独立篡改且两者不能通信。本文把该模型推广到量子设定：两个不通信的本地量子篡改操作，且允许它们之间事先共享任意纠缠，敌手能力显著增强。作者聚焦于最坏情况下的经典消息（即任意分布、非均匀的消息），此前 Batra、Boddu 与 Jain 基于置换的两分裂构造仅对均匀随机消息达到接近 1/5 的速率。本文保留该构造的整体架构，但把置换的均匀消息输入改为“指定消息 + 新鲜均匀填充”的拼接形式，并给出针对这一修改的最坏情况安全性归约，这是全文的核心技术贡献。主要结果：对任意足够小的固定 ξ>0 与足够大的第一份额长度 n，编码速率至少为 1/5−ξ，具有完美正确性，错误概率为 2^{−n^{Ω(1)}}；安全性对每一个消息都成立，且对每种攻击只需一个与消息无关的模拟器。该工作解决了纠缠两分裂状态模型下最坏情况经典消息的常数速率问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 非可塑编码是抗篡改存储、密钥保护与多方协议安全的基础原语。本文首次在最坏情况经典消息、且敌手具备预先共享量子纠缠的两分裂模型下达到常数速率，属于信息论安全边界的实质性推进，长期影响密码工程与量子安全设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 属于理论密码学与量子信息交叉成果，短期内不直接对应现网漏洞或攻击面；可迁移方向包括抗篡改硬件/固件存储、白盒与物理攻击防护、量子时代多方协议的编码层设计，以及后续速率与模型泛化研究。

items.title: Supersingularity and Superspeciality Verification of Abelian Surfaces
items.summary: Supersingular abelian surfaces are essential in isogeny-based cryptography. Despite this, we have no efficient algorithm to verify if a given abelian surface is supersingular. In this work, we initiate this research topic by giving an efficient Monte Carlo algorithm to verify if an abelian surface over $\mathbb{F}_p$ is supersingular in $O(\log p)$ with negligible failure probability, and an efficient conclusive algorithm if the order is smooth. We derive this algorithm by a careful analysis on the structure of supersingular Jacobians over $\mathbb{F}_p$. Furthermore, we derive efficient algorithms to verify if an abelian variety of any dimension is minimal or maximal, and to verify if a Jacobian of any dimension is superspecial.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于同源密码学（isogeny-based cryptography）中的核心代数对象——超奇异阿贝尔曲面（supersingular abelian surfaces）。超奇异阿贝尔曲面在同源密码协议（如基于同源的后量子方案）中扮演关键角色，但一个长期存在的空白是：给定一个阿贝尔曲面，业界并没有高效算法去验证它究竟是不是超奇异的。作者由此开启该研究课题。其核心贡献是：第一，提出一个高效的蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）算法，可在 O(log p) 时间内判定定义在有限域 F_p 上的阿贝尔曲面是否为超奇异，且失败概率可忽略；第二，当相关阶（order）是光滑数时，进一步给出一个高效且结论确定的（conclusive）算法，即输出结果可被严格验证而非仅有高概率保证。算法并非拼凑，而是建立在对 F_p 上超奇异 Jacobian 结构的细致分析之上。第三，作者把方法推广，给出高效算法用于判定任意维数的阿贝尔簇是否为极小（minimal）或极大（maximal），以及判定任意维数的 Jacobian 是否为超特殊（superspecial）。整体上，这是一项数论与密码学交叉的理论工作，为同源密码中'参数合法性校验'这一环节提供了可证明的算法工具，适合数论、密码学协议设计者以及关注后量子密码实现安全的读者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 同源密码（含后量子方案）的安全性建立在超奇异对象假设之上，而此前缺乏高效验证手段，导致参数生成与公钥校验存在盲区。该工作给出可证明复杂度的验证算法，对协议参数合法性与恶意参数检测具有潜在价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至同源密码协议/库的参数选取与校验逻辑、公钥与曲线数据合法性检查、后量子密码实现的参数审计与测试用例设计；也影响超奇异对象相关数学工具的工程化使用。

跟踪该算法是否被工程化实现，以及是否被纳入后量子密码标准或库的参数验证流程。
在内部密码评估中，将'参数合法性验证缺失'列为同源类方案的风险点，提前设计验证用例。

items.title: MultiTable: A Faster Hash Table at any Physical Load Factor up to and Including One
items.summary: We present \emph{multitable} and its Rust reference implementation: a stable hash table both materially faster at equal physical memory and more flexible than the SwissTable in its Rust's hashbrown implementation. As an arithmetic mean over 84 configurations it delivers $\mathbf{2.1\times}$ hashbrown's throughput when both hash the same raw bytes and $\mathbf{1.9\times}$ when hashbrown is keyed on native integers, its best case; on negative lookups alone, $3.2\times$ and $2.9\times$. Multitable reaches \textbf{any physical load factor} up to and \textbf{including one} ($0.9999$ demonstrated), exactly for the requested capacity, compared to hashbrown which doubles at $0.777$ for 4-byte keys and values. At $75\%$ saturation of hashbrown (assumed average case of its rigid ladder) and multitable sized to $0.97$ physical load factor, hashbrown takes $66\%$ more space. The lookup probe count has no cliff as the load factor approaches one. Bucket size, physical load factor, and failure budget are parameters, and the multitable can be grown without rehashing. We implement two variants of multitable: plain and filtered. At equal physical memory on an Apple M2 Pro the filtered multitable leads hashbrown in all $84$ insert, hit, and miss configurations. Multitable is more \textbf{memory-efficient}, at equal mixed-lookup throughput on the map of $4$-byte keys and values the filtered multitable needs up to $12\%$ fewer bytes than hashbrown, and the plain multitable is $18\%$ smaller, holding $\mathbf{22\%}$ more keys in the same memory.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文提出了一种名为 multitable 的哈希表数据结构，并给出其 Rust 参考实现。作者的核心论点是：在同等物理内存占用下，multitable 比 Rust hashbrown 所实现的 SwissTable 明显更快，且灵活性更高。作者在 84 种配置上取算术平均进行对比：当两者对相同原始字节序列做哈希时，multitable 的吞吐量约为 hashbrown 的 2.1 倍；当 hashbrown 以原生整数为键（即其最优场景）时，multitable 仍达 1.9 倍；仅在未命中（negative lookup）场景下，两者分别为 3.2 倍和 2.9 倍。

结构层面的关键差异在于负载因子的可控性。SwissTable/hashbrown 采用刚性扩容阶梯，对 4 字节键值而言在 0.777 负载因子时就翻倍扩容；而 multitable 可以支持任意物理负载因子，直至并包含 1.0（论文演示了 0.9999），并且容量严格贴合请求值。作者指出，当 hashbrown 达到其 75% 饱和（论文假设为其刚性阶梯下的平均情形）、multitable 取 0.97 物理负载因子时，hashbrown 多占用约 66% 的空间。此外，multitable 的查找探测次数在负载因子趋近 1 时不存在性能悬崖，这一点不同于传统开放寻址表。桶大小、物理负载因子与失败预算（failure budget）都是可调参数，且该表可在不重新哈希（rehash）的前提下扩容。

实现上作者给出 plain 与 filtered 两个变体。在 Apple M2 Pro 上、等物理内存条件下，filtered 变体在全部 84 个插入、命中、未命中配置中都优于 hashbrown。内存效率方面：在 4 字节键值映射上取得同等混合查找吞吐时，filtered multitable 相比 hashbrown 最多可少用 12% 的字节；plain 变体则小 18%，并在相同内存中多容纳 22% 的键。论文归入 cs.DS、math.CO 与 math.PR，说明其除数据结构工程外，还包含组合与概率层面的探测行为分析。适合对高性能哈希表、内存受限系统、Rust 生态基础设施库以及哈希碰撞鲁棒性感兴趣的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 哈希表是解析器、网络栈、代理与运行时中广泛使用的核心组件，其负载因子上限与探测行为直接关系到内存放大、拒绝服务风险与容量规划。multitable 在同等内存下吞吐更高、支持接近 1.0 的负载因子且无探测悬崖，值得评估其能否用于内存受限或高对抗性输入场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至高性能服务、嵌入式与内存受限环境、Rust 基础设施库替代评估，以及需要严格控制内存放大比的数据平面组件；论文的失败预算参数化设计也为在对抗性键分布下权衡性能与稳定性提供了新思路。
defense_advice_zh: 在内部基准环境中复现论文的 84 组配置对比，重点验证自身业务键型（字节串 vs 原生整数、命中/未命中比例）下的真实收益
评估将高负载因子能力用于内存受限组件时，是否会放大哈希碰撞型拒绝服务的影响，并确认失败预算参数的可配置与可监控性
关注 Rust 生态中 hashbrown 替代方案的成熟度与维护状态，避免在生产依赖中引入缺乏长期支持的新库
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders
items.summary: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. Experiments conducted on the Ransomware Dataset 2024 demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in binary classification tasks. Across one to fifty shot settings, the proposed model consistently achieves high accuracy, F1 score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient values, maintaining reliable classification even under extreme scarcity. These results highlight the model's robustness and effectiveness in adapting to limited data scenarios, demonstrating the potential of combining feature extraction with meta learning to enhance resilience against malware, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and public infrastructure, where cyberattacks can cause significant operational and financial disruption.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文针对勒索软件检测中「新样本稀缺、标注数据不足」这一现实痛点，提出了一套混合深度学习框架，将自编码器特征提取器（Autoencoder Feature Extractor, AFE）与模型无关元学习分类器（Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning, MAML）结合，用于少样本（few-shot）恶意软件检测。

研究背景：论文指出勒索软件已成为主要网络安全威胁，攻击事件在关键行业（医疗、制造、公共基础设施等）中频率与破坏力持续上升。典型入侵路径包括钓鱼邮件、恶意下载以及利用软件漏洞获取系统权限；一旦进入系统，恶意程序会加密文件并以加密货币形式索要赎金换取解密密钥。作者强调，传统检测方法在面对全新家族或样本极度稀缺的变种时表现不佳，导致系统处于暴露状态。

核心方法：框架分为两级。第一级 AFE 负责从原始样本中学习紧凑的潜在表示，起到降噪与降维作用，把高维、含冗余的输入压缩为更具判别力的特征向量，从而减轻后续分类器的学习负担并提升泛化能力。第二级 MAML 分类器采用元学习范式，通过在一批「任务」上学习一组易于快速微调的初始化参数，使其仅凭少量带标签样本即可迅速适配到新的恶意软件类别或新出现的威胁变体。这种组合的动机在于：特征提取解决「表示质量」，元学习解决「样本效率」，两者互补。

实验与结果：作者在 Ransomware Dataset 2024 上开展二分类实验，覆盖 1-shot 至 50-shot 的多种少样本设置。报告称模型在准确率、F1 分数与马修斯相关系数（MCC）上均保持较高且稳定的水平，即使在极端缺乏标注样本的条件下仍能维持可靠分类，体现出较强的鲁棒性与快速适应能力。

主要贡献可归纳为三点：一是提出 AFE+MAML 的混合少样本检测架构；二是通过 1 到 50 shot 的系统性实验验证其在样本稀缺下的稳定性；三是论证了「特征提取 + 元学习」组合在提升勒索软件防御韧性方面的潜力，并指出其对医疗、制造与公共基础设施等停机或数据损失代价高昂的行业具有应用价值。

适合读者：从事恶意软件检测、少样本/元学习、终端与勒索软件防护研究的学术界与工业界安全工程师。需注意，本文摘要未提供数据集构成、误报率、对抗鲁棒性及真实生产环境部署验证等细节。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 勒索软件变种迭代快、标注样本稀缺，是传统监督检测的主要盲区。该工作把元学习引入少样本勒索软件识别，为 SOC 在「新家族刚出现、样本极少」的窗口期快速构建可用检测模型提供了一条可迁移思路，值得作为检测工程的技术储备跟踪。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到端点检测与响应（EDR）、文件加密行为早期识别、勒索软件家族快速上线检测模型等场景；尤其适用于医疗、制造、公共基础设施等缺乏大规模标注样本、但停机代价极高的行业环境。当前仅基于公开数据集验证，尚未证明在生产流量与对抗条件下的有效性。
detection_signals_zh: 文件被批量加密与扩展名异常变更的行为特征
勒索说明文件（ransom note）落地与加密货币支付指示文本
钓鱼邮件附件与恶意下载引入的可疑进程链
利用软件漏洞提权后出现的异常加密/写入行为
defense_advice_zh: 在自有样本上复现该少样本流程，评估仅用少量新家族样本时的准确率与误报率，再决定是否纳入检测管线
将该方法定位为「新家族冷启动」的补充检测通道，而非替代现有基于签名与行为的检测
同步建设高质量良性样本库与勒索软件家族标注库，元学习效果高度依赖任务划分与样本质量
结合端点行为遥测（进程链、文件操作、加密速率）作为特征来源，弥补静态样本特征在真实环境中的局限
对模型输出设置人工复核与阈值回退机制，避免少样本模型在分布外样本上产生高置信误判
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware
items.summary: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注物联网（IoT）设备爆发式增长带来的恶意软件威胁问题。作者指出，预计到 2030 年全球 IoT 设备将达 400 亿台，广泛覆盖工业、医疗、农业、汽车以及楼宇与家居自动化等领域；由于多数设备缺乏足够的内置安全机制，形成了巨大的攻击面，攻击者可通过漏洞植入恶意软件、窃取敏感数据并索要赎金。现有安全防护措施已跟不上 IoT 的扩张速度，以及由此带来的每日新增恶意软件变种的增速。针对这一缺口，作者提出一种新的恶意软件检测与分类框架，用于保护设备并提升 IoT 系统的健壮性与安全性。其核心方法采用结构化状态空间序列模型（Structured State Space Sequence，S4）：该模型将恶意软件样本的序列离散化处理，并捕捉长距离依赖关系，从而识别隐含在恶意软件执行流中的“因”与“果”关系，即执行行为之间的远期关联。论文声称有两项新颖贡献：一是 S4 模型在恶意软件分析领域的首次实证应用；二是将该模型与其他深度学习架构进行较为全面的性能对比，为这一新范式下的后续研究奠定基础。需要注意的是，摘要仅提及方法思路与贡献定位，未给出数据集规模、类别数量、评估指标数值、误报率、推理开销或与具体基线模型的量化对比结果，也未涉及对抗样本鲁棒性与实际部署条件，因此其实际效果仍待正文验证。适合恶意软件分析、IoT 安全与深度学习序列建模方向的研究人员和检测工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: IoT 恶意软件变种增速已超出传统特征与浅层模型的处理能力，S4 类状态空间模型在长序列依赖建模上具备潜力，可能成为恶意软件行为序列分类的新检测路线，值得防御方跟踪评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 IoT 固件沙箱行为序列分类、系统调用/API 调用序列的多家族恶意软件识别、端点 EDR 行为链建模等场景；若验证有效，可作为现有 CNN/RNN/Transformer 检测器的补充或替代方案。
detection_signals_zh: IoT 设备执行流的系统调用/API 调用序列中出现异常长距离关联模式（如初期探测行为与后期数据外发行为相隔很远但语义相关）
序列模型对多家族恶意软件的分类置信度与家族标签分布出现偏移，可作为模型漂移监测指标
设备侧出现与既有基线行为序列不符的离散化 token 序列片段
defense_advice_zh: 关注 S4/Mamba 类状态空间模型在行为序列分类任务上的开源实现，评估其相对 CNN、LSTM、Transformer 的精度与推理延迟权衡
在内部沙箱中准备按家族标注的 IoT 恶意软件行为序列数据集，复现论文实验以验证其泛化能力
将该类模型作为辅助检测通道而非唯一判据，保留基于规则与信誉的兜底逻辑，控制误报导致的运维成本
持续监测公开数据集中恶意软件家族的演进，定期重训序列模型以应对变种漂移

items.title: Blind Unforgeability implies Plus-One Unforgeability
items.summary: We prove that quantum blind-unforgeability implies quantum plus-one unforgeability, settling an open question in the literature. Since plus-one unforgeability is known not to imply blind-unforgeability, our result establishes that blind-unforgeability is \emph{strictly stronger} than plus-one unforgeability in the quantum setting. The implication is proven using a new \emph{smoothing} technique that coherently rescales the query histories of a quantum-query algorithm in a black-box manner. This enables us to transform any successful plus-one attacker into a blind-unforgeability attacker with only inverse-polynomial loss. Our proof represents a conceptual shift from merely extracting a useful query history as in earlier attempts, which we show inevitably fails in general, to first coherently reshaping how query histories interfere.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
这是一篇量子密码学理论论文，研究量子环境下“不可伪造性”这一安全定义之间的关系。在经典和量子消息认证码（MAC）/认证加密的安全性刻画中，敌手被允许以叠加态对认证预言机发起量子查询，因此需要专门的不可伪造性定义。文献中两个重要概念是 blind-unforgeability（盲不可伪造性）与 plus-one unforgeability（加一不可伪造性）：前者对敌手可提交的查询历史施加更强的限制，后者相对宽松。此前已知 plus-one 不可伪造性并不能推出 blind 不可伪造性，但反向是否成立——即 blind 不可伪造性是否蕴含 plus-one 不可伪造性——一直是未解决的公开问题。本文给出了肯定的答案，从而完整地确定了二者的强弱关系：在量子设定下，blind-unforgeability 严格强于 plus-one unforgeability。

技术层面，作者提出了一种新的“平滑化（smoothing）”技术：以黑盒方式对量子查询算法的查询历史进行相干地重新缩放（coherently rescale），而不是仅仅从敌手的查询历史中“抽取”出可用的那部分信息。基于这一变换，作者能够把任意一个成功的 plus-one 攻击者转化为一个 blind-unforgeability 攻击者，且安全性的损失仅为多项式倒数级别（inverse-polynomial loss），即在归约中保持了可接受的优势。作者同时指出，早期试图通过“提取有用查询历史”来证明该蕴含的路线在一般情况下必然失败，因此本文的做法是一次概念性的转变：先相干地重塑查询历史之间的干涉方式，再据此完成归约。论文属于 quant-ph 分类，主要面向量子密码学与可证明安全方向的研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它厘清了量子不可伪造性定义的层级关系，直接影响量子安全认证方案（量子 MAC、认证加密等）该以哪个定义作为安全目标与证明标准。若仍在较弱的 plus-one 定义下作安全性论证，其提供的保证严格弱于 blind 定义下的保证，评审与选型时需注意这一差异。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到量子安全消息认证码、认证加密以及依赖计算假设认证的量子通信协议（如 QKD 后处理中的认证环节）的安全定义选择与归约证明。设计者在宣称方案“量子不可伪造”时，需明确其满足的是哪一档定义；采用 blind-unforgeability 可获得更强保障，但可能对构造提出更高要求。
defense_advice_zh: 在评审或选用量子安全的认证/不可伪造性方案时，明确要求说明所满足的安全定义档次，优先采用 blind-unforgeability 这类更强的定义。
重新检视既有量子 MAC/认证方案的安全性证明，判断其结论是否仅依赖 plus-one 不可伪造性，并评估在更强定义下是否仍然成立。
关注“平滑化”这一相干重缩放归约技术，它可能被复用于其他量子查询敌手模型的归约构造中。

items.title: Exponential quantum speedup for $\mathbb{F}_3^n$-Subset-Sum? Or, rigorous classical algorithms for Binary-Error LWE
items.summary: We study vector subset sum over $\mathbb{F}_3^n$: given $m$ random vectors from $\mathbb{F}_3^n$, find a nonempty subset that sums to zero; the smaller $m$, the more difficult it is to find such a subset. Chen, Liu, and Zhandry (EUROCRYPT'22) introduced an efficient quantum algorithm that solves this problem when $m\approx n^2/2$, where a naive classical algorithm would require exponential time. Subsequently, Kothari, O'Donnell, and Wu (STOC'2026) gave an efficient classical algorithm that only requires $m \approx n^2/3$ vectors, thus removing the hope for an exponential quantum advantage in this parameter regime. Using the framework of Chen, Liu, and Zhandry, we give quantum algorithms that require much fewer input vectors, renewing the possibility of an exponential quantum speedup: for any fixed $ε>0$, our quantum algorithm solves $\mathbb{F}_3$-subset sum in polynomial time with $m=ε\cdot n^2$ vectors. More generally, we establish a full sample--time tradeoff that interpolates between exponential and polynomial runtime. The main ingredient is a deterministic classical algorithm for the binary-error Learning-with-Errors problem, which is of independent cryptographic interest. For this, we rigorously establish a sample--time tradeoff that was predicted by earlier algebraic heuristics. For vector subset sums over larger fields, we also significantly improve classical algorithms in Kothari, O'Donnell, and Wu (STOC'2026).

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究有限域 F_3^n 上的向量子集和问题：给定 m 个 F_3^n 中的随机向量，寻找一个非空子集使其和为零；输入向量数 m 越小，问题越难。此前 Chen、Liu 与 Zhandry（EUROCRYPT'22）提出了高效量子算法，在 m≈n²/2 时可求解该问题，而朴素经典算法需要指数时间；随后 Kothari、O'Donnell 与 Wu（STOC'2026）给出高效经典算法，仅需 m≈n²/3 个向量，从而在该参数区间内消除了量子指数加速的希望。本文沿用 Chen-Liu-Zhandry 的框架，构造出所需输入向量更少的量子算法，重新点燃指数级量子加速的可能性：对任意固定 ε>0，其量子算法在仅给定 m=ε·n² 个向量时即可多项式时间求解 F_3-子集和。更一般地，作者建立了完整的『样本量—运行时间』权衡关系，可在指数与多项式运行时间之间连续插值。其核心技术构件是一个针对二元错误 LWE（Binary-Error LWE）的确定性经典算法，该结果被认为具有独立的密码学价值：作者严格证明了此前仅由代数启发式所预测的样本—时间权衡，为 LWE 类困难假设的参数评估提供了严谨依据。此外，对更大有限域上的向量子集和问题，本文也显著改进了 STOC'2026 的经典算法。整体而言，这是一项理论复杂度与密码分析交叉的成果，同时涉及量子算法优势边界与 LWE 困难性假设。</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>
<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="why_it_matters_zh" string="true">LWE 是后量子密码的核心困难假设。本文为二元错误 LWE 给出严格的样本—时间权衡，可能影响基于 LWE 方案的参数安全裕度评估，并为子集和类问题的量子与经典算法边界提供新证据。</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>
<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="impact_zh" string="true">适用于后量子密码参数评估、LWE 密码分析、格与编码困难问题研究；提示 PQC 迁移与密码敏捷性团队关注二元错误 LWE 变体的参数选择与安全裕度。</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>

items.title: The Real Cookie Banner: GDPR & ePrivacy Cookie Consent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.5 ...
items.summary: The Real Cookie Banner: GDPR & ePrivacy Cookie Consent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Malicious script payloads placed in the title attribute of an anchor tag survive WordPress's comment kses filter at save time, as the payload is only promoted to executable HTML attributes when the plugin's page-wide regex strips the closing quote delimiter at render time; exploitability is therefore subject to the standard comment moderation workflow before the comment is publicly displayed.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-92977 是 WordPress 插件 Real Cookie Banner: GDPR & ePrivacy Cookie Consent 中的一个存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）漏洞，影响范围覆盖该插件直至 5.3.5 的全部版本（即 <= 5.3.5 的所有发行版）。根据 NVD 的元数据描述，漏洞根因是插件在处理用户提交的评论内容时，输入消毒（input sanitization）与输出转义（output escaping）均不充分，导致不可信内容能够以未净化形式进入页面渲染流程。攻击者无需通过认证即可提交评论，一旦恶意内容被保存并在前台页面呈现，访问该页面的任意用户（包括站点管理员）浏览器都会执行其中的脚本，从而可能造成会话令牌窃取、后台操作冒充、页面内容篡改或对访客的钓鱼跳转等后果。NVD 给出 CVSS 3.1 基础评分 7.2，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N，属于高危级别：网络可达、无需权限、无需用户交互、且作用域发生变化（S:C），意味着影响可跨越安全边界波及其他组件，虽然机密性与完整性影响被评估为低、可用性无影响，但组合起来仍足以构成实质性风险。描述中同时指出，恶意内容需先经由 WordPress 评论保存流程，因此在展示之前会受站点既有的评论审核（moderation）工作流约束，攻击的可达性依赖于目标站点是否开放评论、是否对匿名评论执行自动审批以及审核策略的宽严程度。需特别说明的是，当前输入中未提供 EPSS 评分，也明确标注该漏洞未被列入 CISA KEV、且无在野利用的证据记录，因此不应推断其已被实际利用或已武器化。防御方应将其视为需要尽快修复的高危代码缺陷，重点关注受影响插件的版本盘点、评论功能暴露面以及内容安全策略等纵深缓解措施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证攻击者即可借助评论功能向页面注入存储型脚本，多类站点（含访客与管理后台）均可能受影响，CVSS 7.2 且作用域变更。评论审核流程会降低实际可达性，但未修补站点仍存在持久化 XSS 风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致访客与管理员浏览器中执行任意脚本，引发会话劫持、越权操作、页面篡改与钓鱼跳转；因作用域变更（S:C），影响可能超出该插件本身而波及同源其他组件。当前无在野利用证据。

items.title: The Paid Membership Plugin, Ecommerce, User Registration Form, Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content – ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-S...
items.summary: The Paid Membership Plugin, Ecommerce, User Registration Form, Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content – ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via ppress_billing_address Filename Parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. The vulnerability is exploitable via any page hosting the ProfilePress Tabbed Widget by supplying a malicious filename for the ppress_billing_address file upload field in a crafted POST request.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本漏洞为 WordPress 平台 ProfilePress 插件中的反射型跨站脚本（Reflected XSS）问题，编号 CVE-2026-92551，由 NVD 披露。ProfilePress 是一款被广泛使用的会员/电商/用户注册与登录/用户资料及内容限制综合插件，因此受影响的 WordPress 站点数量可能较大。问题根源在于插件对 ppress_billing_address 文件上传字段中的“文件名”参数缺乏足够的输入净化（input sanitization），同时在输出回显到页面时也未做充分的转义（output escaping），导致攻击者可控的数据能够以脚本形式被浏览器解析执行。根据描述，该缺陷影响 4.17.4 及之前的所有版本。利用方式上，攻击者无需任何认证（PR:N），只需构造一个带有恶意文件名的 POST 请求，即可在承载 ProfilePress Tabbed Widget（选项卡式小工具）的任意页面上注入任意 Web 脚本；但脚本的执行仍依赖受害者交互（UI:R）——攻击者需要诱骗已登录或普通用户点击特制链接或执行某个操作，脚本才会在其浏览器上下文中运行。CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.1，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N，攻击面在网络层、复杂度低且无需权限，但因需要用户交互且作用域变更（S:C）而属于中等风险。该漏洞可能被用于会话劫持、页面内容篡改、钓鱼跳转或凭据窃取等常见 XSS 后续利用。当前情报显示该漏洞未被列入 CISA KEV，也未标注已在野利用，因此主要风险来自大规模自动化扫描与后续可能的公开利用代码，防御方应优先完成版本升级并加固边界防护。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ProfilePress 装机量大，未认证攻击者即可借助特制请求在站点页面注入脚本，一旦用户被诱导点击，可能造成会话劫持、钓鱼跳转与内容篡改。当前未标记在野利用与 KEV，但对 WordPress 站点而言修复成本低、收益高，应尽快处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致反射型 XSS：在受害者浏览器上下文中执行任意脚本，进而窃取会话 Cookie/令牌、伪造页面内容、实施钓鱼重定向或劫持用户操作。影响范围为所有运行 ProfilePress <= 4.17.4 的 WordPress 站点，需用户交互触发，故单次攻击面有限但可批量投递链接。

items.title: The LearnPress – WordPress LMS Plugin for Create and Sell Online Courses plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'orderby' paramet...
items.summary: The LearnPress – WordPress LMS Plugin for Create and Sell Online Courses plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'orderby' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link.

llm_summary.summary_zh: WordPress 插件 LearnPress（用于创建和销售在线课程的 LMS 插件）被披露存在反射型 DOM 型跨站脚本漏洞（CVE-2026-92538）。该漏洞影响所有版本直至并包括 4.4.7，根源在于对 'orderby' 参数处理时输入清理不足与输出转义不当。攻击者无需认证，可通过构造恶意链接诱导用户点击，将任意 Web 脚本注入页面并在受害者浏览器中执行。由于是 DOM 型 XSS，恶意脚本在客户端动态执行，可能绕过服务端过滤，给检测带来一定难度。CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.1（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N），属于中危。成功利用可导致会话劫持、页面篡改、敏感信息窃取，甚至结合其他漏洞实现更进一步的攻击。目前 NVD 未提供 EPSS 评分，也未被列入 KEV 或在野利用标记，但鉴于 WordPress 插件广泛部署，风险不容忽视。建议尽快升级至 4.4.7 之后版本，并采取缓解措施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LearnPress 是广泛使用的 WordPress LMS 插件，该反射型 DOM XSS 无需认证即可利用，虽需用户交互，但通过钓鱼链接易得手，可能危害站点用户会话与数据安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可注入并执行任意客户端脚本，导致会话令牌窃取、敏感信息泄露、页面内容篡改，或在受害者浏览器上下文中执行未授权操作。

items.title: The Paid Membership Plugin, Ecommerce, User Registration Form, Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content – ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Informa...
items.summary: The Paid Membership Plugin, Ecommerce, User Registration Form, Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content – ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.4 via the get_user_profile_structure. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to extract other users' email addresses, login names, and registration dates via the Member Directory's per-row user rebinding when attacker-controlled base64 payloads in the [pp-custom-html] shortcode invoke [profile-email], [profile-username], and [profile-date-registered]. When the WordPress users_can_register option is enabled, unauthenticated attackers can also exploit this vulnerability by supplying the split shortcode fragments through the plugin's own registration handler, which processes the reg_nickname and reg_bio fields without a nonce requirement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 2026 年披露的 CVE-2026-92536 影响 WordPress 的 ProfilePress 插件（全称 Paid Membership Plugin, Ecommerce, User Registration Form, Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content），该插件广泛用于会员管理、电商、用户注册与内容限制。漏洞位于 get_user_profile_structure 函数，属于敏感信息暴露类型，所有版本直至 4.17.4（含）均受影响。攻击者可分两类：第一，已通过认证且权限低至 subscriber 级别的用户，可利用 Member Directory（会员目录）在逐行渲染用户信息时的用户重绑定缺陷，结合自定义 HTML 短代码中攻击者可控的编码参数，调用用户资料字段，从而批量提取其他用户的电子邮箱、登录名和注册时间。第二，当 WordPress 的 users_can_register 选项开启（允许公开注册）时，未认证攻击者也可通过插件自带的注册处理程序，利用其处理 reg_nickname 和 reg_bio 字段时未强制 nonce 校验的缺陷，注入拆分后的短代码片段，达到同样的信息提取效果。CVSS 3.1 评分为 8.8（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），属高危。漏洞无需用户交互，但利用需要网络可达且（多数场景）具备低权限账号。目前 NVD 元数据未显示在野利用或 KEV 收录。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ProfilePress 装机量庞大，subscriber 级账号即可批量导出用户邮箱与登录名；开放注册的站点甚至无需账号即可利用。泄露的 PII 可直接用于钓鱼与撞库，建议尽快升级至 4.17.4 以上版本并限制注册入口。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致 WordPress 站点用户敏感个人信息泄露，包括电子邮箱地址、登录用户名和注册日期。这些数据可被用于鱼叉式钓鱼、撞库攻击、垃圾邮件、社会工程及后续横向渗透。由于漏洞还允许未认证攻击者在开放注册的站点上利用，影响面可能进一步扩大。CVSS 8.8 反映机密性、完整性、可用性均为高影响。

items.title: The SupportCandy – AI Customer Support Ticket System & Live Chatbot Agent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'sort_by' parameter in all versi...
items.summary: The SupportCandy – AI Customer Support Ticket System & Live Chatbot Agent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'sort_by' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.3 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires the authenticated attacker to hold both a Subscriber-level (or higher) WordPress role and a SupportCandy Agent account with the 'Assign Agents' permission configured.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-94539 是 WordPress 插件 SupportCandy – AI Customer Support Ticket System & Live Chatbot Agent（AI 客服工单系统与实时聊天机器人代理）中的一个基于时间的 SQL 注入漏洞。该插件所有版本（含最新受影响版本 3.5.3）在处理用户可控的 'sort_by' 参数时，未对输入进行充分的转义，且底层 SQL 查询也未采用充分的预处理（参数化）机制，导致攻击者可以将额外的 SQL 语句拼接进原本的查询中。由于这是基于时间的盲注（time-based SQL Injection），攻击者无需在响应中看到查询结果，只需通过构造条件性延时语句并观察服务器响应时间的差异，即可逐位推断数据库中的内容。触发该漏洞需要身份认证：攻击者必须同时具备两项条件——其一是 WordPress 侧 Subscriber 级别或更高权限的用户角色，其二是已配置了 'Assign Agents'（分配坐席）权限的 SupportCandy Agent 账户。满足条件后，攻击者可借此读取数据库中的敏感信息，例如用户账号、会话令牌、工单内容以及其它存储在 WordPress 数据库表中的业务数据。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.5（向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N），表明攻击可远程发起、复杂度低、无需用户交互，但需要低权限认证；对机密性造成高影响，对完整性与可用性无直接影响。截至本次情报生成时，该条目未列入 CISA KEV，来源字段也未标注在野利用事实，因此不应推断其已被实际利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 客服工单类插件通常承载大量客户信息与内部账号数据，且 Subscriber 级别账号在开放注册的 WordPress 站点上极易获取，配合坐席权限即可形成可利用路径。低权限认证用户即可通过时间盲注逐位窃取数据库敏感数据，风险不应因 CVSS 6.5 而被低估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 具备 Subscriber 及以上角色并拥有 SupportCandy 'Assign Agents' 权限的攻击者，可在无需用户交互的情况下远程读取数据库中的敏感信息，导致客户数据、账号凭据与工单内容等机密性被破坏；完整性与可用性不受直接影响。未列入 KEV，无在野利用标注。

items.title: The Ultimate Member – User Profile, Registration, Login, Member Directory, Content Restriction & Membership Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in ...
items.summary: The Ultimate Member – User Profile, Registration, Login, Member Directory, Content Restriction & Membership Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.13.1 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to view privacy-restricted member profile field values — including fields explicitly configured as owner-only, members-only, or role-restricted — by querying the publicly accessible wp_ajax_nopriv_um_get_members endpoint. The nonce required by the endpoint ('um-frontend-nonce') is emitted to all unauthenticated visitors via wp_localize_script, meaning it provides no meaningful access control and any anonymous visitor can satisfy the endpoint's authentication requirements.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响 WordPress 平台上的 Ultimate Member 插件——一个集用户资料、注册登录、会员目录、内容限制与会员管理于一体的流行插件。根据 NVD 元数据，所有版本直至并包含 2.13.1 均受此授权绕过问题影响。根本原因在于插件在执行特定操作前没有正确校验当前请求方是否具备该操作所需的权限，即缺少对调用者身份与角色的有效授权判断，而不是加密或输入过滤层面的缺陷。具体而言，插件通过公开可访问的 AJAX 接口 um_get_members（对应 wp_ajax_nopriv_um_get_members，即面向未登录用户的入口）向外提供会员数据查询能力。该接口名义上依赖一个名为 um-frontend-nonce 的随机数作为访问凭据，但该 nonce 会被 wp_localize_script 注入并分发给所有未认证的站点访客，因此任何匿名访问者都可以自动获得这一所谓凭据，nonce 实际上不具备任何访问控制作用，无法区分合法用户与攻击者。攻击者无需登录或持有任何账号，即可借助该接口枚举并读取本应受隐私设置保护的会员资料字段值，包括被明确配置为仅本人可见（owner-only）、仅会员可见（members-only）或限定特定角色可见的字段。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.5，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N，即远程、低复杂度、无需权限、无需交互，仅造成机密性高影响，不涉及完整性与可用性。由于这是信息泄露类问题，主要风险是会员隐私数据（如联系方式、身份属性、角色归属等）被批量收集，可能进一步用于社会工程、定向钓鱼或精准骚扰。当前元数据未显示该漏洞已被列入 KEV 或在野利用，EPSS 分值缺失，因此暂按未被利用处理，但鉴于利用门槛极低，建议尽快修复。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证访问者即可批量读取被标记为仅本人、仅会员或角色受限的会员隐私字段，暴露面覆盖所有使用该插件的公开站点。利用门槛极低（无需账号与交互），隐私数据一旦泄露易被用于定向钓鱼与社会工程，且元数据未显示已有在野利用或 KEV 收录，属于应尽快处置的高危信息泄露问题。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 机密性高影响：任意匿名访客可绕过隐私配置，读取会员资料中受限制字段，造成个人身份与联系方式等敏感信息泄露；不涉及数据篡改或服务中断。受影响版本为 Ultimate Member 2.13.1 及之前的所有版本。

items.summary: Multidict is an implementation of a multidict data structure. Applications that perform these operations over attacker-influenced sequences can leak two strong references per element, and garbage collection cannot reclaim them, so repeated operations can cause unbounded process memory growth and denial of service. Forward union, intersection, non-tuple operand elements, and pure-Python builds are not affected by this reference leak. This issue is fixed in version 6.9.1.

From 0.1.45 until 0.4.4, the langgraph-sdk resource-scoped authorization decorators @auth.on.threads, @auth.on.assistants, and @auth.on.crons ignore the actions argument and register the selected handler for every action on the resource. Because that wildcard resource handler is selected before broader fallback handlers, an authenticated user may bypass fallback action, ownership, or permission checks and read, update, or delete another user's resource. Only Python deployments using actions on the affected decorators are vulnerable, and a deployment remains protected when the selected handler independently enforces all required checks for every action it receives. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.4.

items.summary: The Angular SSR is a server-rise rendering tool for Angular applications. The non-special resolve:// URL base preserves the backslash, path.join interprets it as a Windows separator, and the pagePath.startsWith(normalize(publicPath)) check incorrectly accepts a sibling output directory whose name shares the configured public-directory prefix. An unauthenticated requester can therefore retrieve a sibling prerendered HTML page when that page contains the Angular SSG marker. The issue is limited to Windows deployments that pass relative request URLs to CommonEngine.render, have a prefix-sharing sibling output directory, and contain qualifying prerendered Angular HTML; it does not provide arbitrary file read. This issue is fixed in versions 20.3.36, 21.2.23, and 22.1.7.

items.summary: oRPC is a tool that helps build APIs that are end-to-end type-safe and adhere to OpenAPI standards. Prior to 1.14.10, the @orpc/zod ZodSmartCoercionPlugin and experimental_ZodSmartCoercionPlugin collect object and record properties in plain objects and resolve shape keys through the prototype chain. A remote client that can reach a procedure with an object or record input can supply __proto__ to replace the prototype of the returned request object, allowing attacker-controlled inherited values to reach application lookups. For object schemas, keys such as constructor, toString, and __proto__ can instead resolve inherited members as Zod schemas and cause an unhandled TypeError before validation. The global Object.prototype, unrelated objects, other requests, and other users are not modified, and the availability effect is limited to crafted requests rather than persistent process-wide state. This issue is fixed in version 1.14.10.

items.summary: probe-image-size gets image dimensions without downloading the entire file. Prior to 7.4.0, lib/parse_sync/svg.js and lib/parse_stream/svg.js use the searching regular expression /<[-_.:a-zA-Z0-9][^>]*>/, which repeatedly scans to the end of input when attacker-controlled data contains many less-than characters without a closing greater-than character. The synchronous parser converts and scans the full supplied buffer without an input cap, while the streaming parser reparses the complete accumulated SVG prefix for every received chunk. The probe.sync(), probe(stream), and probe(url) entry points can therefore block the Node.js event loop at full CPU, and attacker-controlled chunking can amplify the streaming cost. This issue is fixed in version 7.4.0.

A pull request or repository configuration change can therefore execute commands with the release job's privileges and expose registry credentials or cloud tokens, and dry-run publishing does not prevent the vulnerable pre-check command from executing. This issue is fixed in versions 22.7.8 and 23.1.1.

items.summary: Nx is a monorepo solution for TypeScript and polyglot codebases. From 14.6.0 until 22.7.9 and 23.1.2, Nx creates Unix domain sockets for its daemon and isolated plugin workers in shared temporary locations without owner-only directory and socket permissions. Another unprivileged local account on a shared build server, developer host, or multi-user container can discover and connect to a running socket because the transport performs no authentication and relies on filesystem containment. The daemon's PROCESS_IN_BACKGROUND request accepts a module path and invokes its default export, allowing a caller that controls a file to execute code as the account running Nx; other handlers can expose workspace file contents, project graphs, and task hashes. Disabling the daemon alone does not remove the vulnerable plugin-worker sockets, while single-user machines without another local account are not exposed. This issue is fixed in versions 22.7.9 and 23.1.2.

Applications are affected only when they pass their own second-argument options object to pool.run(); calls without that argument use the trusted default options object. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.2.

Applications without images.remotePatterns are not affected. Administrators unable to upgrade should audit allow-listed hosts and avoid entries whose DNS records are not trusted. This issue is fixed in version 16.3.8.

items.title:
MISP contains an improper access control vulnerability in its attribute search and paginated attribute view endpoints.

When a user queries for soft-deleted attributes (e.g., vi...
items.summary:
MISP contains an improper access control vulnerability in its attribute search and paginated attribute view endpoints.

When a user queries for soft-deleted attributes (e.g., via the deleted-attributes search or the paginated attribute listing), the application returned soft-deleted attributes belonging to events owned by other organizations to any authenticated user who had visibility of the event. The event detail view correctly restricted soft-deleted attribute visibility to the owning organization and sync-permission users, but the attribute search and paginated view code paths lacked this restriction.

Preconditions:

- An authenticated MISP user with at least read access to an event owned by another organization.

- The user issues a query for deleted attributes (search or paginated view with the deleted filter).

Impact:

- Confidentiality: Soft-deleted threat intelligence attributes (e.g., IOCs, indicators, context) from other organizations are disclosed to unauthorized users. This may expose sensitive intelligence that the owning organization intended to remove from general visibility.

Affected versions: MISP versions prior to v2.5.48.

items.title: MISP contains an authorization flaw in its correlation handling during attribute searches. When a user performs an attribute search that triggers correlation lookups, the system...
items.summary:
MISP contains an authorization flaw in its correlation handling during attribute searches. When a user performs an attribute search that triggers correlation lookups, the system authorized access to correlated attributes and events based on a stale distribution snapshot stored on the correlation row rather than the live event access control list.

Because the correlation row's distribution columns are a point-in-time copy that lacks a published flag, the authorization check becomes incorrect when an event is subsequently restricted (for example, its sharing group is changed or it is unpublished). As a result, an authenticated user could retrieve attributes and event details belonging to events they no longer have permission to view.

Preconditions:

- An authenticated user with at least read access to some events in the instance.

- The existence of correlations between events, at least one of which has been restricted after the correlation was created.

Impact:

- Confidentiality: exposure of attribute values and event metadata that the user is not authorized to access.

Affected versions: MISP prior to v2.5.48.

items.title: MISP contains an authorization bypass in the related events listing functionality. When a user requests the list of events correlated to a given event, the system retrieved rela...
items.summary:
MISP contains an authorization bypass in the related events listing functionality. When a user requests the list of events correlated to a given event, the system retrieved related event metadata directly from the correlation table without re-validating the caller's access rights against each related event.

The correlation table stores a snapshot of the event's distribution level and sharing group at the time the correlation was created, and does not carry the published flag. As a result, events that the caller is not permitted to open—because they are unpublished, or because their distribution or sharing group has changed since the correlation was recorded—were still returned with their metadata (title, date, correlating value counts).

Preconditions:

- An authenticated user with access to at least one event in MISP.

- The existence of correlation entries linking that event to other events the user should not be able to view.

Impact:

- Unauthorized disclosure of event metadata (titles, dates, correlation counts) for events the user has no right to access.

- Potential reconnaissance of threat-intelligence event names and timelines across sharing groups.

Affected: MISP versions prior to the fix commit (2ffa97f05).

items.title: MISP contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the decaying model import functionality. The import endpoint was intended to create a new decaying model belonging ex...
items.summary:
MISP contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the decaying model import functionality. The import endpoint was intended to create a new decaying model belonging exclusively to the importing user's organisation, with the default flag forced to off.

However, the application stripped only the top-level id and uuid fields and pinned org_id and default on the outer array before saving the data flat. A user with decaying-model permissions could supply a nested model key carrying its own primary key, organisation identifier, and default flag, which bypassed those guards during the save operation.

Impact:

- A user with perm_decaying could overwrite an existing decaying model belonging to another organisation in place, altering its name, formula, parameters, or ownership.

- A user could create or modify a model flagged as the organisation default, affecting scoring behaviour for other users.

- A user could reassign a model's organisation to an arbitrary value.

Preconditions:

- Authenticated user with decaying-model permission (perm_decaying).

- Network access to the MISP instance.

Affected: <2.5.48.

items.summary:
MISP contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the remote event preview page. When a linked (remote) MISP server is configured, the event preview renders tag identifiers inside an inline JavaScript onclick attribute. The tag ID value was HTML-escaped but not sanitized for the JavaScript string context, meaning a malicious linked server could supply a tag ID containing characters (such as a single quote) that break out of the JavaScript string literal and inject arbitrary script.

Preconditions:

- A linked/remote MISP server is configured and connected to the local instance.

- The linked server supplies a crafted tag ID in an event.

- An authenticated user views the event preview and interacts with the affected tag element.

Impact:

- Arbitrary JavaScript execution in the context of the viewing user's browser session, potentially allowing session hijacking, data exfiltration, or unauthorized actions on behalf of the user.

Affected versions: MISP prior to the fix commit (v2.5.48 or later, exact boundary unconfirmed).

items.summary:
MISP contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the TAXII object viewer. When displaying a remote TAXII object, the JSON content of string properties was rendered directly into an HTML pre block without HTML-encoding. An attacker who can control or influence the content of a TAXII object (e.g., by publishing a malicious object to a TAXII server that the victim's MISP instance subscribes to) can inject arbitrary HTML or JavaScript that executes in the context of the victim's MISP session.

Preconditions:

- The victim must be an authenticated MISP user with access to the TAXII object viewer.

- The victim must open or view the crafted TAXII object.

Impact:

- Execution of arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser within the MISP application context.

- Potential theft of session tokens, API keys, or other sensitive data accessible from the MISP interface.

- Potential for performing actions on behalf of the authenticated user.

Affected versions: <2.5.48.

items.summary:
MISP contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the ID Translator feature. When a user views the ID Translator page, the application queries linked (remote) MISP servers for corresponding event identifiers. The event ID returned by the remote server was rendered in the HTML output without proper output encoding.

A malicious or compromised linked server could return a crafted event ID containing arbitrary HTML or JavaScript markup. This markup would be rendered in the browser of any user in the host organization who views the ID Translator page, enabling session hijacking, credential theft, or other client-side attacks.

Preconditions:

- The victim must be an authenticated user of the host MISP instance.

- A linked server must be configured on the host instance.

- The victim must navigate to the ID Translator page for a given event.

Affected versions: <2.5.48.

items.title: MISP contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the index table rendering of the remote event preview. The count field template escaped the associated link UR...
items.summary:
MISP contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the index table rendering of the remote event preview. The count field template escaped the associated link URL but rendered the field value without HTML encoding. An attacker with the ability to create or modify events on a linked (remote) MISP server could craft an event identifier containing HTML or JavaScript markup. When a user on the local MISP instance views the remote event preview index, the unescaped value is rendered directly in the browser, allowing arbitrary script execution in the victim's session.

Preconditions:

- A linked/remote MISP server is configured and connected to the local instance.

- The attacker has sufficient access on the linked server to create or modify an event with a crafted identifier.

- A victim user on the local instance views the remote event preview index page.

Impact:

- Execution of arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the MISP web application.

- Potential session hijacking, data exfiltration, or unauthorized actions performed on behalf of the authenticated user.

Affected versions: <2.5.48.

items.title: Seroval facilitates JS value stringification, including complex structures beyond JSON.stringify capabilities. Prior to 1.6.3, deserializeTypedArray in fromJSON and fromCrossJSO...
items.summary: Seroval facilitates JS value stringification, including complex structures beyond JSON.stringify capabilities. Prior to 1.6.3, deserializeTypedArray in fromJSON and fromCrossJSON trusts a deserialized source value as an ArrayBuffer and does not bound the serialized element count. An attacker can provide a small untrusted JSON object with a large length value, causing the array-like TypedArray constructor to synchronously allocate the selected number of elements and exhaust CPU or memory while starving the event loop. The offset check does not reject the crafted source because source.byteLength is undefined. DataView reaches a similar unchecked cast but throws rather than allocating, and the issue has no identified confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.3.
